records.name: The Ammonia Lyceum (Athaip WR-H d11-7577)
records.description: Body 3 b a is a nested moon close to its parent atmospheric body, which features green glowing reflections at certain times of the day.

records.name: Dueling Rings (Qiefaa EB-U d4-20)
records.description: A wide-ringed Class II Gas Giant with a ringed icy moon on an inclined orbit around its parent.

records.name: Cyanean Rocks (Synuefe WH-F c0)
records.description: Jason and The Argonauts, tells of a pair of deadly rocks that would clash together whenever any living thing tried to pass between them. Two moons in this system collide every 8.1 days

records.name: Guardian Ruins - IC 4673 nebula (HEN 2-333)
records.description: An area that contains a large number of Guardian ruins, centered around the IC 4673 nebula, which has been locked down by the Pilot's Federation.

records.name: Blooming With Life (Thraikoo FL-P d5-97)
records.description: A tourist beacon far from the bubble, in a system with a great variety of life.

records.name: Amundsen's Star (Lyed YJ-I d9-0)
records.description: The farthest Southerly system currently reachable, and an area of Gyre Trees.

records.name: Azura Initiative (Great Annihilator)
records.description: A player-hosted bubble comprised of carriers in a 150 ly sphere around this system.

records.name: Dancing Rings of Atabey (Xothaei WR-A d14-49)
records.description: A gas giant hosting 4 water world moons, three of which are ringed.

records.name: Sagittarius A* (Sagittarius A*)
records.description: The Milky Way's central supermassive black hole.

records.name: Explorer's Anchorage (Stuemeae FG-Y d7561)
records.description: A small scientific hub near Sagittarius A*, Explorer's Anchorage is the second-farthest starport from Sol.

records.name: Colonia (Colonia)
records.description: The largest human settlement outside the Sol region, consisting of over seventy inhabited systems.

records.name: The Zurara (megaship wreckage) (Syreadiae JX-F c0)
records.description: The wreckage of the Zurara, a megaship that was involved in the secretive Project Dynasty. Audio logs of the sabotage that destroyed the ship can still be retrieved from data uplinks.

records.name: Beagle Point (Beagle Point)
records.description: A famous expedition destination, which used to be the farthest reachable system from Sol, from 3300 to 3302.

records.name: Project Dynasty: Conflux settlements (Pru Aescs TY-J a64-1)
records.description: A cluster of abandoned settlements linked to Project Dynasty, which sent an ill-fated expedition into this region, as well as to two other regions.

records.name: Project Dynasty: Hawking's Gap settlements (Plaa Aec IZ-N c20-1)
records.description: A cluster of abandoned settlements linked to Project Dynasty, which sent an ill-fated expedition into this region, as well as to two other regions.

records.name: Project Dynasty: Formidine Rift settlements (Eafots EU-R c4-1)
records.description: A cluster of abandoned settlements linked to Project Dynasty, which sent an ill-fated expedition into the Formidine Rift, as well as to two other regions.

records.name: Five Emperors (M36 Sector RI-T c3-5)
records.description: A rare example of five planets sharing common barycentres, locked in a complex dance.

records.name: Undine Haven (Phroi Bluae LS-B d13-744)
records.description: While relatively unassuming at first glance, this system boasts a total of six terraforming candidate water worlds, plus a seventh terraformable planet, a high metal content world.

records.name: G2 Dust Cloud (G2 Dust Cloud Sector JH-V c2-2851)
records.description: A faint cloud that has survived an encounter with Sagittarius A*.

records.name: Great Annihilator (Great Annihilator)
records.description: A famous pair of black holes, originally discovered in the 20th century. Currently housing the Azura Initiative.

records.name: Arjun's Vault (Iowhaik ZQ-C d13-320)
records.description: A system with a plethora of scenic rings.

records.name: Metztli, Tranquility (Metztli)
records.description: The first Earth-like world to be colonized far from the old worlds, and one of the first systems to be colonized in Colonia.

records.name: Taylor's Ring (Sifou MU-N c7-0)
records.description: Class IV GG with a very thin ring. This discovery became the namesake for the phenomenon.

records.name: Meowzipan's Playground (Eulail QX-T d3-181)
records.description: A scenic memorial system near the Cat's Perch Nebula.

records.name: The Trojan Cat (Cat's Paw Sector HR-W d1-29)
records.description: A pair of Trojan worlds with excellent views of the Cat's Paw Nebula.

records.name: Rhubarb and Custard (KOI 413)
records.description: Rhubarb and Custard are a pair of gas giants that collide approximately every 40 days.

records.name: Collection of Lesser Wonders (Phoi Scraa AA-A h711)
records.description: A system with two Black Holes, a ringed White Dwarf, and a ringed Neutron Star.

records.name: Guardian Ruins - Eta Carina nebula (Eta Carina Sector EL-Y d16)
records.description: An area containing ancient Guardian Ruins, and brain trees.

records.name: Guardian Ruins - NGC 3199 nebula (NGC 3199 Sector IM-V c2-5)
records.description: An area containing ancient Guardian Ruins, and brain trees.

records.name: Guardian Ruins - Prai Hypoo nebula (Prai Hypoo GF-E c10)
records.description: An area containing ancient Guardian Ruins, and brain trees.

records.name: Guardian Ruins - Skaudai nebula (Skaudai AM-B d14-138)
records.description: An area containing ancient Guardian Ruins, and brain trees.

records.name: Guardian Ruins - Blaa Hypai nebula (Blaa Hypai LZ-F b27-0)
records.description: An area containing ancient Guardian Ruins, and brain trees.

records.name: Guardian Ruins - Eorl Auwsy nebula (Eorl Auwsy SY-Z d13-3468)
records.description: An area containing ancient Guardian Ruins, and brain trees.

records.name: Ice Breaker (Phleedgoea TK-M d8-380)
records.description: The shepherd moon of planet B 2 is so close to the icy rings of the planet that the edge of the ring is only 79 km from the surface of the planet, well within the orbital cruise range.

records.name: Brother Wolf and Sister Moon (Phroea Blou ZL-K d9-2810)
records.description: This system has an earth-like Moon and a terraformable water moon orbiting a ringed class III gas giant. The two moons pass within 1 ls of each other every 3.5 days.

records.name: Fields of Elysium (Clooku GR-U d3-112)
records.description: Close, binary, ringed Earth-like worlds.

records.name: Torus Molluscs, Ovomly sector (Ovomly AA-A h22)
records.description: Torus Molluscs can be found here, and this sector produced glitches in the early years of exploration.

records.name: Musica Universalis (Smojoo ZE-R d4-109)
records.description: A strange gas giant with peculiar and rare moons, including a shepherd ELW.

records.name: Green Glory (Praea Euq VP-M c21-1)
records.description: A spectacular Green Gas Giant that is quite close to the human bubble.

records.name: Gyroscope (Chraisuae AA-A h206)
records.description: A moon that passes very close to its parent's rings and has a nearly perpendicular orbit.

records.name: Gates of Alighieri (Blaei Eun CF-E b39-0)
records.description: Planet orbits less than 1.5 ls from its star. Fuel scooping is possible while gliding down to the surface.

records.name: Azure Respite Planetary Nebula (Dumbio YO-A e308)
records.description: A place to stop and rest, traveling between Colonia and points northward toward Beagle Point, bathed in the blue backdrop of this planetary nebula.

records.name: Hengist Nebula and L01-Type Anomalies (Juenae OX-U e2-8852)
records.description: A planetary nebula with spaceborne life inside a Lagrange cloud.

records.name: The Dandelion Anomaly (Systimbau AA-A h63)
records.description: Three close black holes generate anomalous lensing effects.

records.name: Noble Shield (Phraa Hypai YZ-P e5-1)
records.description: A Helium-Rich Gas Giant that closely orbits its parent ringed Y-Dwarf perpendicularly.

records.name: Insomniac's Retreat (Jongoi TN-K d8-0)
records.description: An Earth-like world in the void between spiral arms

records.name: Xeplýnete (Scheau Phoe ZB-B d14-12)
records.description: A Water World hugging a Brown Dwarf's ring.

records.name: A Mercurial Circumnavigation (Smojeia LI-E c14-1)
records.description: Site of a planetary circumnavigation with an SRV, chosen for its small size, and close proximity to the host star, for grand stellar views while traversing the day side of the planet.

records.name: Via Gravitatis (KOI 1701)
records.description: The record holder for highest gravity landable planet, at 45 g.

records.name: Black Sage Fields (Eoch Flyi AA-A g167)
records.description: Black Hole/Neutron Star Binary system with 88 bodies and a considerable variety of bio signs as a result of the neutron star and the high number of atmospheric bodies.

records.name: Cupid and Psyche (Dryoea Flyi BB-W d2-223)
records.description: Extremely close binary, Earth-like moons

records.name: Celestial Slingshot (Oob Aeb XV-P b46-0)
records.description: An ELW with an eccentric and quick orbit.

records.name: Wolf's Vegetarian Delight (HR 6265)
records.description: A smorgasbord of rare organic life to see around a Wolf-Rayet star.

records.name: Gravity Betrothed (Drumboa AA-A h73)
records.description: An Earth-like moon in a system with 2 black holes and a ringed neutron star.

records.name: Hypio Orb nebula and Anomalies (Hypio Pri GN-D c15-1007)
records.description: T03-Type Anomalies, related to a nearby planetary nebula.

records.name: Eodgorsts Anomaly Clusters (Eodgorsts UR-W d1-77)
records.description: Three clusters of systems, each housing a different type of Anomalies.

records.name: Rusalka's Trilemma (Scaulae ZL-C d13-11)
records.description: A ringed Gas Giant with Water-based Life circled by three watery moons: a ringed Earth-Like World, a second Earth-Like World, and a ringed Water World.

records.name: Gas Escarlata (Chroabs HH-V d2-75)
records.description: The hottest gas giant in the galaxy with a temperature of 13,712 K, surpassing the runner-up by 5,925 K.

records.name: Alastor (Flyoo Groa SO-Z e0)
records.description: A planetary nebula that is home to the Stolon Trees and Pods.

records.name: The Ice Serpent Mountains (Wredguia LC-I c24-3)
records.description: Body 6 A. A snaking range, rising above a frozen seabed.

records.name: The Grey Spires (Wredguia PP-L c22-4)
records.description: Body A 5. A collection of high, frosted rock spires, under the bow of the world's ring.

records.name: Takane's Peak (Wredguia KP-L c22-2)
records.description: Body B 1. A lonely mountain, upon a desert plain.

records.name: Between the Rings (Mynoaw LC-L d8-1429)
records.description: Located near nebula, this system contains a ringed moon that has a stunning view of its parent planet's rings.

records.name: Monde de la Mort/World of Death (Spoihaae XE-X d2-9)
records.description: A world with a surface-observable White Dwarf star at a distance of 0.06 ls.

records.name: Moonraker (Floalk JH-Z c15-13)
records.description: A landable moon that orbits within 200 km from the rings of its parent gas giant.

records.name: Life in the MU-D (Seqaae MU-D d13-3)
records.description: A small planet in a distant system with 10 Biological signals.

records.name: Three's A Crowd (Dehe PP-V d3-57)
records.description: A quite uncommon configuration of trinary shepherd moons orbiting a helium-rich gas giant.

records.name: DSSA Aristarchos (Eocs Aihm XX-U d2-6)
records.description: Anchorage location of the DSSA Aristarchos. All explorations services are available.

records.name: Thracian Planetary Nebula (Thraikoo PS-U e2-4)
records.description: A rich planetary nebula, and former home of the DSSA Inverness.

records.name: DSSA [IGAU] Paradox Destiny (Prai Hypoo TX-B d4)
records.description: DSSA Carrier and nebula research outpost, stationed in the Prai Hypoo (Àrsaidh) Nebula, which hosts Brain Trees, Guardian Ruins, and Notable Stellar Phenomena.

records.name: Au Nain Rouge (Aunaihn AA-A h268)
records.description: A thin atmospheric moon orbiting an Earth-like Moon, close to a dim red dwarf star, around a black hole.

records.name: Jo Ella's Flares (Gru Hypue AA-A g4)
records.description: A closed binary system that consists of Neutron Pulsar and a Black Hole, on the way to Colonia. It also features good views of the nearby nebula and the other celestial bodies within the system.

records.name: Semotus Beacon (Oevasy SG-Y d0)
records.description: The most distant reachable star system from Sol.

records.name: Dr. Kay's Soul and Heart (Dr. Kay's Heart)
records.description: A nebula (Soul) named after Dr. Kay Ross and a system (Heart) with a transmitter repeating her farewell message every hour.

records.name: Battista Tocci Twins (Preae Aec PX-X c3-1)
records.description: The twins are icy bodies that collide approximately every two years and remain conjoined for 24 hours. Named after Giacomo and Giovanni Battista Tocci, conjoined twins from 19th Century Italy.

records.name: Michellins Stars (Smojeia CH-B d14-4)
records.description: This system has four Scoopable stars, the thing that stood out for me was three of them within 37ls of each other and they look wonderful to me

records.name: Lethe Paratiritís (Drojia YW-B d13-4)
records.description: Three landable planets that are in close orbit of two brown dwarf star, which in turn are in close orbit of a white dwarf star. The thin atmospheric planets have beautiful views of the white dwarf.

records.name: Tres Gigantes (Scheau Blao AA-A h457)
records.description: Three gas giants each with a very close orbital landable.

records.name: The Infinity Pools (Hypao Aed YJ-I d9-0)
records.description: Five Water Worlds at the extremity of the Outer Arm

records.name: The Velvet Pearl (Droju CR-L b41-0)
records.description: A hot Jupiter along the Colonia Highway with a relatively interesting deep red hue. It also has an incredibly close proximity to the 2nd star in the system.

records.name: The Cannonball Nebula (Phreia Hypa KI-S e4-1)
records.description: A black hole planetary nebula with a curious circular shape despite having an orbital partner. It also has a close proximity to The Skull and Crossbones Nebula.

records.name: The Compact Quartet (Eos Scraa FG-Y g950)
records.description: A pair of neutron stars and a small black hole, orbiting a central black hole

records.name: Shepherd's Warning (Synuefai ZL-O b51-0)
records.description: A pair of icy moon colliders, one of which (2 a) has a thin argon atmosphere.

records.name: The Centaurus Festival (Byoomi PZ-O e6-5855)
records.description: System features a planetary hourglass nebula, with a black hole core. Thanks to the absence of any other light sources, the nebula lights up the entire system.

records.name: The Sidewinder Grand Prix (Ploi Aihm EN-R d5-8)
records.description: A Taylor ring surrounding a landable planet within a Neutron star system.

records.name: Alkonost (Pyroifoi VD-V c5-58)
records.description: A ringed gas giant with a two moons, one of which is only about 159km away from the outer edge of the ring.

records.name: Rhadamanthus's Eye (Gludgoea AA-A e25)
records.description: One of the more brightly-coloured Green Gas Giants.

records.name: The Rising Runner Missed By Endless Senders (Col 285 Sector RB-R b19-5)
records.description: A double Taylor's ring, and a small moon only 33.2 km away from the ring.

records.name: Distant Home (Truechoi MW-N d6-15)
records.description: Earth-like world in Hieronymus Delta.

records.name: Thueche AA-A h16 Nebula (Thueche Brahe) (Thueche YB-B b5-0)
records.description: The northernmost nebula in the galaxy, by a significant margin.

records.name: NGC 1491 Nebula (NGC 1491 Sector EB-X c1-3)
records.description: The southernmost nebula, at the edge of the Formidine Rift.

records.name: Crooki AA-A h1 Nebula (Lonely Lantern Nebula) (Crooki EV-R b35-1)
records.description: The westernmost nebula in the galaxy, and one of the smallest non-planetary ones.

records.name: Eock Prau AA-A h31 Nebula (Dryman's Proud Nebula) (Eock Prau WS-K c8-0)
records.description: The eastermost nebula in the galaxy, a large one with many colourful Lagrangian clouds around it.

records.name: The Monazite Ring (Wredguia AR-W b56-2)
records.description: An icy body orbiting a ringed ammonia world provides exceptional views of the rings. Named for the brown colour of the ring and the monazite hotspot.

records.name: Stretch's Eye (Truechoae XE-Q b19-4)
records.description: A vast mountain range with a great view of the nearby brown dwarf.

records.name: Viridi Aqua (Eimbaith LW-W e1-290)
records.description: Orbiting a neutron star in distant Ryker's Hope, this is the first known glowing green water giant. There are K10-Type Anomalies within its wide icy rings.

records.name: Neon Beacon (Synookio EI-J d9-1)
records.description: This gas giant, GGG #18, has both the characteristic neon green storms and a distinctive maroon colour that makes it a unique object.

records.name: Monet's Gift (Byoi Aewsy RZ-F d11-104)
records.description: A vividly coloured Green Gas Giant with Water-based Life, close to the Sol-Colonia route.

records.name: Odin's Glory (Eor Aowsy GR-W e1-1381)
records.description: The only known Class IV Green Gas Giant, with wide rings and green cloud bands.

records.name: Emerald Vanguard (Blua Hypa HT-F d12-1226)
records.description: The second Green Gas Giant which was discovered, and the first one that had its location confirmed; to date, it's one of the tiniest ones.

records.name: Viridian Dreams (Nyeajaae IT-M c9-19)
records.description: Situated very close to the Colonia Road waystation world of Rohini, this Glowing Green Gas Giant is a must-see for anyone traveling the Colonia route.

records.name: Icy Muse (Bleia Dryiae HF-W b35-1)
records.description: A colourful green gas giant, one of the earliest discovered ones, with a considerable amount of oxygen in its atmosphere.

records.name: Radioactive Green (Col 285 Sector VU-M c8-1)
records.description: The fourth and last gas giant of this system has an unusual feature - it glows a vivid green.

records.name: A Floofy Giant (Eafoff LN-Q d6-0)
records.description: One of the more impressive-looking green gas giants, which held a lot of "firsts".

records.name: Dreamer Blush (Gongae QW-L c24-0)
records.description: A magnificent ringed glowing green gas giant with deep purple clouds in the Kepler's Crest region.

records.name: Lighthouse of Lemnos (Floasly TE-X d2-25)
records.description: This Green Gas Giant was among the first ones reported, and it was the first one found orbiting a secondary star.

records.name: Wilma and Betty (Juenae HP-A c3-646)
records.description: Two Earth-Like Worlds orbiting each other at a distance of 0.65 ls.

records.name: Distant Wonder (Pro Flee UY-Q c18-0)
records.description: Planet 2 in this system is a stunning pink and white ringed Class I giant capped by vivid green poles.

records.name: Neverest II (Trapezium Sector YT-A c9)
records.description: Located in body B 4, visitors can find a 9.6 km high mountain under a pastel sky.

records.name: The Mother of all Solar Systems (Ellaid AA-A h5)
records.description: On the edge of the Temple region, this system features 25 stars in a single system, 23 of which are T-Tauri stars. At least 10 of them are visible from the entry point.

records.name: Slotin's Latte (Floawns FX-L b36-24)
records.description: Green Gas Giant in the Norma Arm, with a rather unique colouring, resembling a latte with perhaps too much espresso.

records.name: Disappearing Ring (Wredguia HJ-M b48-1)
records.description: Two ringed bodies have rings so fine that some are impossible to spot. The close proximity of the bodies and their shepherd moon has been known to cause anomalous gravitational effects.

records.name: Columbus's Light (Issarm JC-C d13-0)
records.description: Issarm JC-C d13-0 is dominated by a red giant with exactly one solar mass and also exactly 30 solar radius.

records.name: Mairon Star (Egnairs AA-A h72)
records.description: A wide-ringed neutron star orbiting a black hole.

records.name: The Giant and the Dwarfs (Droett VC-U b3-1)
records.description: Two small landable icy moons, in a close binary orbit with each other, are orbiting a gas giant on a close orbit, resulting in a good sight.

records.name: Racing Cones (Blae Drye KM-D d12-12)
records.description: This Neutron/K-Type Star pair orbit each other every 7.3 hours at ~5 ls apart.

records.name: Abeona's Blessing (Dryooe Prou FF-Z d696)
records.description: A Green Gas Giant with Water Based Life with beautiful green and crimson cloud bands.

records.name: Prunes and Magnesia (KOI 232)
records.description: Two class III gas giants collide in this system approximately every 29 days. So named because it is more regular than the other colliding gas giants, Rhubarb and Custard.

records.name: The Bright Blue Dot (Flyae Flyuae QT-Q e5-9421)
records.description: Single Earth-Like orbiting 4 stars.

records.name: The Blink of an Eye (Phraa Flyoo TZ-O e6-922)
records.description: Planet C 1's orbit drops into the exclusion zone of a White Dwarf (DC) Star

records.name: Aestheticum (Pleia Thio AR-M d7-0)
records.description: The 4 a moon is a ringed landable thin oxygen atmosphere world, orbiting a gas giant with wide rings. This world has stunning sunrises with the distant class A primary refracting neon pink at dawn.

records.name: Plio's Sphere (Plio Chruia VY-U b2-2)
records.description: An Icy world with an incredibly high temperature on a tight orbit around a secondary Brown Dwarf. It has a surface gravity of 2 g and has a 19,000 kilometer radius.

records.name: Big Top Circus Act (Phrae Eaeb KQ-Y c16-1)
records.description: An icy ringed landable moon orbiting a wide ringed Class I gas giant at a near perpendicular angle, to create a stunning view from both the surface and close orbit.

records.name: Halo's Shepherd (Hedgo RB-W c2-0)
records.description: Planet 3 a orbits closely enough to its gas giant parent that asteroids from the bright edge of the giant's icy rings are visible.

records.name: Gigantor's Temple (Greae Hypa PH-C d1017)
records.description: This system harbors Gigantor, the largest currently known landable planet (with a radius of 28,878 km) in the galaxy. It also features an atmospheric world relatively close to a ringed brown dwarf.

records.name: Footfall's Limit (Greae Hypa IW-N d6-266)
records.description: Very close to Dr. Kay's Heart, this 20,467 KM landable is perhaps the largest walkable currently known. Visitors should beware of scorching temperatures and high gravity both.

records.name: OGLE-2005-BLG-169Lb (OGLE-05-169L)
records.description: This system is home to extrasolar object OGLE-2005-BLG-169Lb, recorded using optical gravitational lensing.

records.name: Eulail AA-A h2 Nebula (Cat's Perch Nebula) (Eulail QX-T d3-103)
records.description: Situated 1,700 ly above the galactic plane, the Eulail AA-A h2 (nicknamed "Cat's Perch nebula") offers a spectacular view of the Milky Way.

records.name: Phoi Phyloea AA-A h167 Nebula - Black Smoke Nebula (Freasai QL-P c5-0)
records.description: At 2,500 ly above the galactic plane, this is the highest large nebula.

records.name: Myumbai AA-A h235 Nebula (Sunken Spire Nebula) (Myumbai OK-D c13-11)
records.description: Situated 2,100 ly below the galactic plane, this nebula is the lowest one in the galaxy.

records.name: Egnaix AA-A h91 Nebula (Spirit Nebula) (Egnaix GW-V e2-0)
records.description: One of the highest nebulae, around 2,300 ly above the galactic plane.

records.name: Blue Garden (Egnaix DN-O b25-0)
records.description: The Blue Garden is an icy moon (4 b) in the vicinity of the Spirit Nebula, with a peculiar sunset, flora and rings.

records.name: Double Trouble (Dryoi Flyao HE-B c29-177)
records.description: Prepare for trouble and make it double! A binary pair of Earth-like Worlds.

records.name: Shards of Perdition (Slegaa AR-I c11-0)
records.description: This system features two rare atmospheric bodies (B 3 and B 6) that have crystalline shards: a very rare combination to have in a single system.

records.name: Troubled Paradise (Egnaix AA-A g51)
records.description: In this system lies an Earth-Like World, with an O-Class Star being the primary star in the system. This is one of the first ELW discoveries with an O-class star as the primary star.

records.name: Diamonds in the Rough (Hypao Chraea VQ-T d4-8)
records.description: From a distance this known Green Gas Giant appears as a fairly dull, khaki shade of green, however a trip closer to the surface rewards the pilot with some more striking colours.

records.name: Pearled Arches (Outotl HM-B c14-4)
records.description: This ringed icy moon, orbiting a ringed gas giant parent, offers spectacular views under a nitrogen atmosphere.

records.name: Elysian Gardens (Ridgoo BF-Q d5-61)
records.description: Planet A 1 d hides an amazing diversity of lifeforms. Nine distinct types of xenoflora dot the surface, including osseus, cactoida, and tubus plants.

records.name: Death's Dance (Hypio Proo VE-Q e5-1485)
records.description: A pair of white dwarfs dancing silently in the night, lulling the unsuspecting planets to their demise.

records.name: Blue Lagoon (Plio Aip QM-W d1-48)
records.description: Archival entry about a curious phenomenon, which will only be visible again in many years. A moon's thin atmosphere appears as a thick blue fog when its parent gas giant eclipses the system's star.

records.name: Goliath (Chroabs TI-S d4-58)
records.description: The second largest landable body in the Milky Way, Goliath has a staggering 24,404 km radius. It also features high gravity, at 4 times that of Earth.

records.name: Eord Prau AA-A h12 Nebula (Rubinus Nebula) (Eord Prau YP-N d7-2745)
records.description: A medium sized dark nebula.

records.name: Blue Button Planetary Nebula (Eord Prau MS-T e3-265)
records.description: A black hole orbited by two gas giants in a blue planetary nebula.

records.name: Prai Hypoo AA-A h60 Nebula (Àrsaidh Nebula) (Prai Hypoo SA-I b0)
records.description: A nebula containing Guardian ruins and Notable Stellar Phenomena.

records.name: Hell Port (asteroid base) (Seagull Sector DL-Y d3)
records.description: A system housing a remote asteroid base, which used to be the farthest shipyard in the South-East.

records.name: Elephant's Trunk Mine (asteroid base) (GM Cephei)
records.description: A remote asteroid base, and numerous surface settlements, all dedicated to mining.

records.name: New Growth (asteroid base) (Pencil Sector EL-Y d5)
records.description: An asteroid base dedicated to terraforming, close to Guardian ruins.

records.name: Iris Vacations (asteroid base) (FW Cephei)
records.description: A remote asteroid base, with beautiful views of the nearby Iris nebula.

records.name: Mic Turner Research Base (California Sector BA-A e6)
records.description: Mic Turner base is an Alliance research base named after one of the founders. The planet has a number of Thargoid Barnacle sites including one hidden in a building. The bark mounds are now extinct.

records.name: Mammon (asteroid base), IC 1287 Nebula (Mammon)
records.description: Mammon Monitoring Facility is an asteroid base in the IC 1287 Nebula, a small planetary nebula surrounding a B class star.

records.name: Distant Ocean Cliffs (Phroi Pri OQ-Y d4354)
records.description: A water world orbiting a ringed brown dwarf only 22,061 km away from its rings.

records.name: Darwin Research Facility (California Sector BV-Y c7)
records.description: An asteroid base in the California Nebula, with over 40 surface installations across the system, and Thargoid Barnacles on planet 5.

records.name: The Gas Giant Stalker (Phroi Byio JU-E d12-19)
records.description: A trojan pair of gas giants, following one another.

records.name: Dual Eden (Hegoi RR-H b37-4)
records.description: Two separate Earth-Like Worlds in the same system, with good views of the nearby Bubble nebula.

records.name: Mahon Research Base (HIP 18077)
records.description: An Alliance base established by Turner Research Group on a planet home to Bark Mounds and Luteolum Anemones, and an attacked bulk cargo ship.

records.name: Bohr's Dice Planetary Nebula (Blaa Hypai DR-V e2-16)
records.description: A small, blue, dual lobed planetary nebula centered around a neutron star that looks like a pair of dice being rolled from the hand of God, represented by the nearby Hollow Veil nebula.

records.name: Goliath's Sling (Groa Eaeb KT-O d7-4)
records.description: Located in Tenebrae, the last gas giant of this system has an unusually large ring surrounding it, which "slings" a ringed gas giant and its three nested moons, creating memorable views.

records.name: Blaa Hypai AA-A h68 Nebula (Hollow Veil Nebula) (Blaa Hypai AI-I b26-1)
records.description: A medium sized dark nebula which is mostly known for containing Guardian ruins, but it also hosts Notable Stellar Phenomena.

records.name: The Giant's Garden (Dryio Flyi ZU-Y d2985)
records.description: A ringed Earth-Like World orbiting a Red Giant star.

records.name: Eorl Auwsy AA-A h72 Nebula (Epiphany Nebula) (Eorl Auwsy LX-Z c27-215)
records.description: A faint, reddish nebula near the galactic core, with Guardian ruins in some of its surrounding systems.

records.name: The Magic Forest (Blaa Hypai LA-J c11-3)
records.description: This particular forest of Fonticulua is blessed with high voltage Electricae mixed into the entrance, creating a magical view of the nearby planetary nebula Bohr's Dice over the horizon.

records.name: Rubia (Dryoea Prao FH-S d5-3063)
records.description: A beautiful predominantly pink and white Green Gas Giant

records.name: Evelyn's Light (Evelyn's Light)
records.description: A tourist beacon near Colonia is a memorial for Commander Jellowiggler's daughter, Evelyn Faye Roy, who passed away at 11 years of age. Stop by to hear her heartbeat and recieve a message from her.

records.name: AMP Plains (NGC 6842 Sector PD-S b4-0)
records.description: 1.7 ly from NGC 6842, this system is illuminated not just by its star, but also the planetary nebula. It features a stunning view of the Nebula, complemented with Electricae, on the 1 a moon.

records.name: Two in Tow (Gludgoe DU-E c25-5)
records.description: Three Moons in tight trinary orbit around a gas giant

records.name: Jade Green Pentagon (Lysoovsky BH-L d8-26)
records.description: A green gas giant with a unique coloration: the green is concentrated around one pole of the planet, and forms a pentagon.

records.name: Eta Carina Amber Fields (Eta Carina Sector JH-V c2-9)
records.description: A system near the edge of the Eta Carina nebula which contains Notable Stellar Phenomena points of interest, with bell molluscs and crystals within.

records.name: Malcolm's World (Hyuedau LV-Y d34)
records.description: Planet 4 a has eight biological signals, with an atmosphere consisting primarily of water and a surface temperature of 423 K.

records.name: Rings of Paradise (Chraufai ND-J d9-2)
records.description:
Located West of the bubble, this system holds an amazing view of a triple ringed 
Helium Rich Gas Giant from the surface of its second moon, with an argon atmosphere.

records.name: Odin's Monocle (Dryoea Flyuae EB-X e1-877)
records.description: A black hole 12 ly away from a planetary nebula in Odin's Hold, giving great lensing effects.

records.name: Black Lightning (Dryio Flyuae KM-W f1-3293)
records.description: Black Hole system with no primary stars hosts a body with Electricae Pluma - which contradicts the Codex.

records.name: Crucible's Harvest (Phoo Flaae CA-A f1)
records.description: A metal-rich body with a landable Hot Thin Silicate Vapour atmosphere bearing life.

records.name: V381 Normae (Black Hole) (V381 Normae)
records.description: Class K Orange Giant V381 Normae orbits 501 ls away from low-mass Black Hole XTE J1550-564.

records.name: Petri Rings (Prieluia RB-X d1-3)
records.description: Life abounds amidst stunning ringed vistas. Molluscs and crystals inhabit a water moon’s ring, closely orbiting a ringed gas giant with water life and a shepherd moon. A purple nebula hovers above.

records.name: Puelaa AA-A h4 Nebula (Devil's Hair Nebula) (Puelaa OD-V b8-0)
records.description: This small red and pink nebula stretches less than ten light-years across, and sits over a thousand light-years above the galactic plane.

records.name: Eolls Graae AA-A h31 Nebula (Bendurion's Present Nebula) (Eolls Graae BG-W d2-44)
records.description: A blue and orange emission nebula 35,400 ly from Sol, situated close to where the Perseus Arm and the Orion Arm begin to diverge.

records.name: Vulcan's Reach (Bya Phla VE-H d10-16)
records.description: An Earth-like World around a gas giant, that has its own landable moon, with volcanism.

records.name: Gru Hypai DL-X e1-20 Nebula (Gru Hypai Stellar Remnant) (Gru Hypai DL-X e1-20)
records.description: A double-globular planetary nebula with a black hole at its centre, containing a dark gas giant with Notable Stellar Phenomena in its rings, including several K02-Type Anomalies.

records.name: Pink Purie (Grie Dryue KO-G d11-38)
records.description: A T-Type star with a landable large radius icy planet in an eccentric orbit that brings the two close together every 4.9 hours.

records.name: Rhapsody in Blue (HIP 111647)
records.description: Much like the early 20th century song, the 4 a moon provides a classical and unique experience. A 100% water atmosphere Rocky body with spectacular blue sky views of close-orbiting ringed worlds.

records.name: Sky Lens (Schee Bli AA-A h143)
records.description: A system with three black holes, where the distortion caused by their gravitational effect is particularly intense and can be seen from the surface of multiple landable bodies.

records.name: Ost-in-Edhil (Syralaei FU-A d33)
records.description: This system contains nine planets, all ringed. Planet 8 has four ringed moons, two of which are also gas giants. Under the right conditions, all five bodies can line up in the same field of view.

records.name: The Proteus Site (Trapezium Sector YU-X c1-2)
records.description: The Proteus is a site on planet 1 A where researchers discovered a battleground between Guardians and Thargoids. Artefacts recovered from here led to the development of the Proteus Wave superweapon.

records.name: Great Orme's Flowers (Pheia Aewsy LV-Y d11)
records.description: A pink-green gas giant with radioactive-green spots seven thousand lightyears south of Sol. Featuring two large green poles, it often takes visitors a second to realize how beautiful it looks.

records.name: Glow Bug Giant (Eol Prou KW-L c8-32)
records.description: A ringed green gas giant notable for its proximity to Colonia, and three large green bands circling its equator.

records.name: Sapphire Sisters (Graea Hypa OR-V d2-105)
records.description: Two deep blue gas giants in close orbit - each sporting a narrow "Taylor's" ring

records.name: Prasinos Soul (Slegi DH-J d10-27)
records.description: This green gas giant has a candy pink colouring with green accents.

records.name: Crystals to Infinity (Syritchi IW-E d11-70)
records.description: In the depths of the Hieronymus Delta, crystal shards grow on three planets in this system. With deposits of polonium, yttrium and ruthenium and all the other ingredients for the premium FSD boost.

records.name: Eldritch Gate's Lost Treasure (Shaulai DL-P d5-274)
records.description: The first Green Gas Giant ever found, originally lost to history, and rediscovered by a thorough investigation seven years later.

records.name: The Sunbathing Giant (Hyuqu JG-X c1-197)
records.description: A hot Jupiter, a mere 4 ls from the main binary star. The second star is 29 ls away.

records.name: Nibbling Cat (Schiqaea WA-V c3-0)
records.description: On this Earth-like world there is a continent in the form of a happy cat, which is nibbling from the neighbouring archipelago.

records.name: Chione's Embrace (Dryio Flyi YE-A g134)
records.description: Icy moon with atmosphere orbiting really close to its parent gas giant, providing a great view from its surface.

records.name: Dionysus Twins (Eorgh Ble CC-K d9-68)
records.description: Gorgeous views of two close binary pairs of Helium-rich Gas Giants, each part of trinary orbits with landable High Metal Content worlds.

records.name: Hephaestus' First Cauldron (HIP 50698)
records.description: This metal rich world is currently (as of 3308-08-25) the hottest landable thin atmosphere planet in the known galaxy, with one of the rarest thin atmosphere types: hot thin silicate vapour.

records.name: Jino's Spires (Auphaibs OY-Y d1-21)
records.description: A high metal content planet with a carbon dioxide atmosphere, a gravity of 1.23 g, and an average temperature of 253 K. Named in memory of the discoverer's late brother.

records.name: Miller Mann (Dryi Aug AA-A h283)
records.description: A landable thin atmospheric HMC planet that, at 12 ls away, has the closest orbit to a black hole, as of 2022-08-28, and also the second-shortest rotation of an atmospheric body.

records.name: Green Aspirant (Syrivu AN-M c7-2)
records.description: The northern-most Green Gas Giant discovered, in the Acheron region. Unfortunately there is no green visible in the surface cloud layers.

records.name: Peppermint Stripes (Oochody AA-Y c17-1)
records.description: A Class I Green Gas Giant with bright maroon stripes somewhat reminiscent of a candy cane.

records.name: In Pink Haze (Syrive KR-W d1-144)
records.description: A Class II Green Gas Giant with spots of green and a pink equatorial cloud band.

records.name: Sliver of Hope (Vegnao PA-S c6-43)
records.description: A Class I Green Gas Giant that has spotty maroon clouds and only a sliver of green color in its upper atmosphere.

records.name: Big MaMas (Kyloaqs ZF-F d11-728)
records.description: A system with a couple of giant M stars having five planets co-orbiting both.

records.name: Explorer´s Happiness (Pro Eur XI-X c28-20)
records.description: An Earth-like world and many water worlds in a young system of only T-Tauri stars.

records.name: Verdant Horizon (Noijo YG-T d4-97)
records.description: A Class II Green Gas Giant with some green and pink clouds sparingly scattered across its surface cloud layers.

records.name: Hammer's Mounds (Preae Ain ST-Z d59)
records.description: This system near the Preae Ain AA-A h29 nebula (nicknamed Hammer nebula) contains a confirmed Bark Mounds sighting on body 1 c a.

records.name: Electric Blues (Greae Hypa CK-R d4-273)
records.description: Exobiologists can find four distinct species of electricae radialem in this white dwarf system less than 60 light-years from Dr. Kay's Heart.

records.name: Hermes' Acolyte (Gludgae RM-W d1-29)
records.description: A Class V Gas Giant which orbits an L-type star every ~5 hours.

records.name: Andvari's Gift (Preou Free QY-R d4-24)
records.description: A system full of ringed worlds - one being a terraformable HMC orbiting a ringed class II giant; and one being slung around its parent star in 5 days, offering a fantastic view from the surface.

records.name: Pharaoh's Rest (Phroea Phio RO-X d2-25)
records.description: Pharaoh's Rest is a ringed moon with a highly inclined orbit around a ringed gas giant. The orbit combined with the moon's thin argon-rich atmosphere provides a beautiful view of its parent body.

records.name: Gravitational Nightmare (Drojia XK-D c26-0)
records.description: A set of five close orbiting bodies which frequently align for stunning views, and two of which regularly collide.

records.name: Palatine-Franconian Lighthouse (Kasu AA-A h0)
records.description: Located in the Outer Arm region, this blue-white supergiant star is only accessible with a fleet carrier, housing a single landable planet with scorching surface temperatures.

records.name: Priestly's Enigma (Gludgae RM-W d1-132)
records.description: A ringed ammonia world without an atmosphere, with Crystalline Shards on one of its two moons.

records.name: Plait's Supernova Remnant (Clookao BB-W e2-20)
records.description: An hourglass shaped supernova remnant, or planetary nebula respectively, glowing intensely in blue and bright green hues.

records.name: Eye of the Prophet (Swoiphs TC-V c5-13)
records.description: The only ringed landable thin ammonia atmosphere planet known, as of 3308-09-20.

records.name: Red Glowing Brothers (Ploi Aihm PE-X d2-9)
records.description: Two nearly identical Red Giants orbiting each other closely, and a landable planet nearby to enjoy the view.

records.name: Eye of Fatima (Drojaea DG-E d12-4)
records.description: A moon circling its parent gas giant's rings at a distance of only 1,140 km, on a slightly inclined orbit.

records.name: Bifrost (Blaa Hypai KP-E d12-45)
records.description: Frigid landable icy moon with two rings and a thin water-rich atmosphere.

records.name: Al’Ameira Dua, Fuca Point (LHS 200)
records.description: An inhabited moon with rings and a thin oxygen atmosphere, orbiting a ringed gas giant relatively closely.

records.name: Trifid Nebula (Trifid Sector DH-K a9-6)
records.description: A larger nebula that houses Collared Pods (NSP), as well as an inhabited system, plus a megaship of the Colonia Bridge.

records.name: Morgan's Rock (NGC 6188 Sector LC-V c2-28)
records.description: One of the more distant remote outposts, found 4,400 ly North from Sol. Recently home to a mysterious criminal organisation.

records.name: The Solar System (Sol)
records.description: The birthplace of Humanity and the capital of the Federation.

records.name: Mordor Ice Rally Circuit (Traikeou KB-X b18-0)
records.description: Located on the A 2 a moon, this is a natural formation that's enclosed by walls which are 2 km high, making it an ideal racing circuit.

records.name: Dance of the Ringed Sextet (Dryau Aowsy KM-V d2-7164)
records.description: A neutron star with six ringed bodies, in trinary, binary and solo configurations.

records.name: The Chained Beast (HD 191612)
records.description: HD 191612 is the only known system with an F-class supergiant star that's in a planetary orbit around another star.

records.name: Wonders Of Boepp (Boepp SU-E d12-1994)
records.description: The Wonders of Boepp is a system inside a large nebula with various interesting bodies and stunning views around them.

records.name: The Dark Star (Splojeia AA-A h19)
records.description: A frozen Wolf-Rayet star with a surface temperature of 113 Kelvin, completely devoid of any light emitted by the star.

records.name: Dance of Decay (Dryi Audst AA-A h108)
records.description: A frozen Wolf-Rayet star with a surface temperature of near absolute zero at 2 Kelvin, in very close binary orbit with a Class O giant of 204 solar radii.

records.name: Latte Verde (Squern AF-N c21-0)
records.description: A latte-colored Class I Green Gas giant scattered with small maroon storms.

records.name: DSSA Destiny Ascension (Scheau Blao TB-A c28-271)
records.description: Previous home system of DSSA Destiny Ascension, soon to be replaced by a new member of the DSSA family.

records.name: DSSA Nameless Mist (Synookiae IF-R d4-20)
records.description: Part of the DSSA Initiative to bridge the gap across the galaxy: Hawkings Gap region.

records.name: Rackham's Peak (HIP 58832)
records.description: At 5,319 ly above the galactic plane, this is the highest visited and highest inhabited system in the galaxy.

records.name: Formorian Sanctuary (Preae Chroa JE-I b23-10)
records.description: A tidally-locked ringed Earth-like world with two trojan moons, both of which are landable.

records.name: Primigenia (Bleia Dryiae FE-B b19-4)
records.description: An Earth-like World with a landable thin atmospheric icy moon at a 0.24 ls distance, with the moon having a sulphur atmosphere with surface volcanism and life.

records.name: The Twilight Realm (Gyruenz AA-A h15)
records.description: A geologically active helium atmospheric planet orbits a cooled-down Wolf-Rayet star. As of 3311. March 13, this is the only known example.

records.name: Terra & Luna Vitae (Eorgh Priae HL-C b46-5)
records.description: An Earth-like world whose moon contains a thin oxygen atmosphere, with life (bacteria) on the surface.

records.name: Gaulkhan's Reach (Fedguia UT-Z c16-10)
records.description: A shepherd moon with geysers that orbits 1,447 km from its parent's rings.

records.name: NGC 6842 Planetary Nebula (CSI+29-19529)
records.description: One of the first discovered planetary nebulae, which was discovered by American astronomer Heber D. Curtis in 1919.

records.name: Eeshorks AA-A h15 Nebula (The Anvil) (Eeshorks ZK-B b2-9)
records.description: A bright emission nebula in a region of active star formation, and one of the two nebulae in the galaxy where the large Reel Molluscs can be found.

records.name: Gagarin Gate (Gru Hypue KS-T d3-31)
records.description: This planetary outpost is part of the Colonia Connection Highway network built in 3302. A great place to replenish and disembark, although without a shipyard.

records.name: Serenity (Iwhophs UJ-R e4-2)
records.description: A star system, only reachable with FSD boosts, that contains a neutron star, an MIII red giant, and multiple landable planets and moons.

records.name: PSR J0751+1807 (Keck Binary Pulsar) (PSR J0751+1807)
records.description: A binary millisecond pulsar and A class star, accompanied by another binary neutron star which is extremely faint and cold in comparison.

records.name: Abaddon (Floawns BX-B d13-109)
records.description: A massive CN carbon star with 7 ringed gas giants, including 2 'hot Jupiter' types, as well many landable moons.

records.name: Maris and Piper (Yuetaea IH-C d0)
records.description: A close pair of "potato" moons with varied biology and geology, and spectacular views.

records.name: Philomela's Rest (Flyiedgoe HG-V d3-30)
records.description: A ringed landable moon with a thin argon atmosphere that circles a wide ringed helium rich gas giant at a nearly perpendicular inclination of 85.14°.

records.name: Jaded Ghost (Plieliae SM-C c29-11)
records.description: A ringed Class II Green Gas Giant (B 3) with three moons, one having a highly inclined orbital path. There are also 3 tritium hotspots within the planet's rings.

records.name: Candy River (Plaa Ain YH-G b13-0)
records.description: A ringed Class I Green Gas Giant with several maroon stripes and vivid green streaks. There are also 6 landable moons and a tritium hotspot.

records.name: The Ammonic Vulcan (Grie Dryue EC-K d9-8)
records.description: This is the largest Ammonia World on record (as of 3308/11/10) with an impressive ring system.

records.name: Sagan Research Centre (asteroid base) (Thor's Helmet Sector FB-X c1-5)
records.description: The Sagan Research Centre is housed within an asteroid near the Thor’s Helmet (NGC 2359) emission nebula.

records.name: Baroque Mantle (Flyiedgiae QZ-M d8-233)
records.description: A Brown Dwarf Y class star (11) which's C Ring measures at a whopping 81.31 ls and also hosts three shepherd moons.

records.name: VY Canis Majoris (VY Canis Majoris)
records.description: The red supergiant VY Canis Majoris is the largest known star in the Milky Way.

records.name: Minerva's Earrings (Qaugnaae GL-Y e0)
records.description: This system houses a brown dwarf star with a huge gap between its ring systems.

records.name: Ruby In The Sky (Greae Phio CB-X d1-600)
records.description: A ringed, landable ice moon with an oxygen atmosphere, orbiting a ringed Y-type brown dwarf at high inclination.

records.name: NGC 3199 Nebula (NGC 3199 Sector LC-V c2-5)
records.description: NGC 3199 is an emission nebula that was created by the now lost Wolf-Rayet star WR 18. It houses Bullet Molluscs  and Guardian ruins.

records.name: Argon Glows (Iowhaik DQ-Y e3143)
records.description: This landable argon-rich world orbits a B class star, and is as of 3308. November the only known example of this combination. It features a unique view of a neighbouring planetary nebula.

records.name: Crimson Bayou (Byoomi XE-X d2-7844)
records.description: A murky Green Gas Giant with Ammonia Based Life with blood-red polar discoloration. It features K-10 anomalies in its rings.

records.name: Gru Hypue AA-A h69 Nebula (Vostok-1 Nebula) (Gru Hypue KS-T d3-27)
records.description: A larger nebula on the Colonia Highway, 1,000 ly below the galactic plane, housing a planetary base as well.

records.name: Lifeless but Waiting (Eephain CG-X e1-1044)
records.description: A very rare atmospheric (thin carbon dioxide-rich), landable and terraformable metal-rich body.

records.name: Singularities' Playground (Mynoaw AA-A h26)
records.description: Four black holes, co-orbited by a white dwarf and a ringed neutron star, all in one system.

records.name: Reienadi Colliders (Reienadi)
records.description: Two surface bases in this system are on bodies that collide up to twice per year.

records.name: Pyramus and Thisbe (Phrooe Flye CA-K b40-5)
records.description: A rare binary combination: a large ringed landable body and a much smaller planet orbit a barycenter that's only slightly beyond the core of the large one.

records.name: Golden Cradle (Drumbaae AA-A h378)
records.description: A close stellar binary consisting of a ringed neutron star and a red giant.

records.name: Aurora Atra (Floawns EG-Y f781)
records.description: A black hole and neutron star system with a landable planet close by, providing some spectacular vistas.

records.name: The Lonely Mountain (Flyiedgai PF-E d12-45)
records.description: A 7 km high mountain on a mostly flat body with thin atmosphere. Nice view of the Flyiedgai nebula, easy to climb, free fall, a nice distraction during exploration.

records.name: Helium-filled sky (Coests NX-U e2-17)
records.description: A moon whose orbit takes it high above the ring of a gas giant.

records.name: Poseidon and Amphitrite (Eord Ploe ZE-A f267)
records.description: Two closely orbiting water worlds in the system of a Herbig Ae/Be protostar.

records.name: Collection of Wonders (Skaude AA-A h294)
records.description: This system contains two black holes, a ringed M-class star, a ringed white dwarf, and a ringed neutron star. A tourist beacon is set up near the ringed M-class star.

records.name: The Devil's Dancefloor (Eeshorks BA-A g2179)
records.description: This system houses a black hole and four neutron stars, with four of the five bodies in close binary pairs. There is also a tourist beacon here.

records.name: Eden's Gate (Dryeia Blou JT-F c25-0)
records.description: Eden's Gate is a collection of closely orbiting ringed worlds with landable moons.

records.name: The Commanders Trap (Eotchofy AA-A h99)
records.description: Black hole system, with a tricky wide ringed gas giant class IV.

records.name: Golden Wings (Cleeque LZ-Y c1-95)
records.description: Double Star System (K and M) with a nice gas giant.

records.name: Frozen smooth purple (Zuneae GI-B d13-2775)
records.description: A beautiful looking icy moon with a thin oxygen atmosphere.

records.name: Polo Harbour (Boewnst KS-S c20-959)
records.description: Planetary outpost near the Venetian Nebula that was built in late 3302 for the Colonia Connection Highway. No shipyard or outfitting, but has great views and is the second closest to Colonia.

records.name: Aryabhata's Shadow (Byae Aip GW-N d6-10)
records.description: A close-orbiting moon that's also close to its parent gas giant's rings, experiencing regular eclipses.

records.name: Eerie Eyes (Pyroifoea SS-Y b15-0)
records.description: A bright Green Gas Giant with Water-Based Life. In addition to its large white icy ring, it is orbited by six landable moons.

records.name: Biologist's Bounty (Wepe KT-Q e5-2274)
records.description: Ten landable Thin Water Atmosphere moons, all around the same gas giant, the current record holder as of 3308/12/18.

records.name: Ringo's Respite (Grie Phoea EH-U e3-9)
records.description: A tightly-grouped trio of bodies orbiting shared barycenters.

records.name: Tilt-a-Whirl (Athaip FE-E d13-3578)
records.description: A ringed gas giant with two sets of binary moons. The first set orbits very close to the ring.

records.name: Glowstrom (Athaip EH-K c25-514)
records.description: An ultra hot gas giant that orbits its primary star at a distance of 3 ls.

records.name: Phipoea AA-A h486 Nebula (Shield Nebula) (Phipoea HJ-D c27-388)
records.description: One of the closest nebulae to Sagittarius A*, a large cloud with a huge amount of systems in and around it, many of them still undiscovered.

records.name: Columbus's Peak (Eorgh Prou SI-J d9-59)
records.description: A small crater with a pointed outcrop, from which you have a fantastic view of the parent gas giant.

records.name: Catherine's Sanatorium (Hypau Auscs YU-Y d105)
records.description: Catherine's Sanatorium is a rare Earth-like moon orbiting a gas giant, with a nested rocky moon of its own.

records.name: Little Dumbbell Nebula (GCRV 950)
records.description: The Little Dumbbell Nebula, also known as Messier 76, NGC 650/651, the Barbell Nebula, or the Cork Nebula, is a planetary nebula in the Elysian Shore. The system features stunning sights and anemones.

records.name: Hot Cappuccino (Dumbooe FQ-B c27-590)
records.description: A hot class V gas giant which orbits its parent red dwarf star at a close distance of  2.88 ls.

records.name: Twin Rubies (Hegaa HJ-E b16-0)
records.description: A massive landable planet orbiting two brown dwarf stars.

records.name: Evaporating Giant (Thailoea TE-V c4-1)
records.description: A Class V Gas Giant that's 5 ls from the main star.

records.name: Under A Steel Sky (Pludgu QK-F d11-0)
records.description: Part of the Saud Kruger Exploration Campaign of 3307, this tourist beacon features an ELW orbiting a neutron star. At a depth of -2,338 ly, visitors can see all of the region's nebulae in the sky.

records.name: Gates of Dawn (Oephaich HC-C d1)
records.description: Ringed landable icy moon with a thin Oxygen atmosphere and sharp-edged mountains, orbiting its wide-ringed Helium Rich Gas Giant parent at an orbital inclination of -35.74°.

records.name: Christiaan's Siblings (Spasau FM-T d4-0)
records.description: A ringed, landable terraforming candidate planet provides a nice view of a Class III gas giant and its rings.

records.name: Neutron Nursery (Gleeque AA-A h317)
records.description: The only known system with three ringed neutron stars, as of 3309/01/26. Features spectacular views, like a ringed M class and a ringed surface view of a ringed neutron star.

records.name: Spectral Vistas (Eok Flyuae AA-A h75)
records.description: The view from within the binary ringed white dwarfs is a sight to behold.

records.name: Mega Moons (Hypoe Prue AA-A h62)
records.description: Ten gas giant moons of a white dwarf star, which orbits a black hole.

records.name: Spring Dawn (Graea Hypue BX-U b6-0)
records.description: Green gas giant with only a small spot of green clouds.

records.name: Hell's Kitchen (Outotz MC-L d8-3)
records.description: Planet B 6 a in this system is an atmospheric moon where explorers can find crystalline shards containing yttrium, as well as rare plants that sustain themselves using geothermal energy.

records.name: The Carousel (Scheau Blou AA-A h55)
records.description: A busy system with multiple close orbiting bodies, most notably a brown dwarf and landable icy body which both complete an orbit around one another in 1.8 hours.

records.name: Hyperion's Rise (Juenae SJ-Q c5-1787)
records.description: A thin atmospheric high metal content world in close proximity to its parent that produces vibrant tableaus.

records.name: Flare Valley (Iowhail TU-M d8-232)
records.description: Landable Metal Rich Body B 1 with an orbital period of 3.7 hours is only 1.68 ls away from its parent flare-active class M dwarf star.

records.name: Hussar Rock (Blua Eoq ZA-L c9-0)
records.description: A mysterious floating stone on the A 1 e moon. It is hidden in a deep and dark gorge.

records.name: Phosphoric Giant (Byoomao LY-G d11-9374)
records.description: A green class III gas giant with a pink haze and vivid green equatorial clouds. There are K10-Type Anomalies within its rings.

records.name: Big Icy and the Dwarfs (Bleae Aewsy SK-D b13-4)
records.description: A large, landable Ice World near two brown dwarfs. The distance to the Y-star is 0.5 ls and to the L-star 5 ls.

records.name: Jemison's Endeavour (Scheareou PS-R d5-11)
records.description: A very rare ringed Earth-like World with two moons.

records.name: The Burning World (Hypaa Byio GN-A d1-17)
records.description: A Class III Gas Giant with pink colouration and a highly eccentric orbit.

records.name: Void Hearts of Epiphany (Shrogaae KK-A d983)
records.description: This is the only known area in the galaxy containing Void Hearts and their Octahedral Pods, as of March 3309.

records.name: Cygnus's Demise (Hypaa Byio CL-Y g0)
records.description: A black hole on the edge of the galaxy.

records.name: Pendulum (Dryau Ausms YE-A f121)
records.description: This system features a black hole, two neutron stars and three landable planets, all within 14 light-seconds distance.

records.name: Poritt's Twins (Scheareou LI-H d11-27)
records.description: Twin close-orbiting binaries provide a potentially dangerous arrival and beautiful views from binary planets.

records.name: The Crescent Abyss (Oochost MR-C d0)
records.description: A very deep, crescent shaped crater, found on body 6, a High Metal Content world with a thin Ammonia Atmosphere.

records.name: The Iron Maiden of AB 1 (Hypaa Byio AG-X d1-0)
records.description: A dense pocket of Caeruleum Peduncle Trees and Pods nestled in a Metal Rich ring of a Class Y Brown Dwarf.

records.name: Thargoid's Teeth (Dryoi Eaec HF-C d14-3)
records.description: Two moons with crystalline shards orbit a ringed Ammonia World in this system.

records.name: Meatball Moon (Dryi Ain AP-I d9-2)
records.description: Body C 1 a in this system has a radius of only 154 km, making it one of the smallest astronomical bodies in the galaxy.

records.name: Behemoth In The Pink (Graea Hypue AL-X d1-48)
records.description: Inclined moon of a gas giant with an oxygen atmosphere. It has Brain Trees and exceptional views of the rings of the gas giant.

records.name: Fisherman and Jinni (Dryi Aescs MG-J c23-0)
records.description: A landable planet on a close (0.9 ls) and fast (2.1 hours) orbit around an L dwarf star.

records.name: Equatorial Jewels (Pru Thae BF-C c27-1)
records.description: A Class II Green Gas Giant with small streaks of pink and green in the equatorial regions.

records.name: Timeless Gate (Dryio Bloo EG-Y g145)
records.description: A closed trinary system that consists of a black hole, a white dwarf and a neutron star. Has wide ringed L-type dwarf and two high inclined moons to ringed parents.

records.name: Raspberry Crème (Flyue Bloae QN-Y c2-0)
records.description: Planet C 1 in this system is a Class II Green Gas Giant with three pronounced pink equatorial cloud bands.

records.name: The Cosmic Lighter (Phoi Bro HG-Y f57)
records.description: Body BC 1 is a landable planet with a thin carbon dioxide - sulphur dioxide atmosphere closely orbiting an M type and White Dwarf binary.

records.name: Rolling Pearls (Bleia Dryiae HO-F a38-1)
records.description: Class L dwarf star orbited every 7 hours by two tidally locked ice worlds in close proximity, and 4.24 ls from the star. One of them has a landable atmosphere.

records.name: DSSA Smilers Observatory (Phleedgoe MY-G d11-275)
records.description: The DSSA carrier Smilers Observatory – to explore deep space and study class A stars.

records.name: Paleta Carmesí (Preou Aip JY-U c2-0)
records.description: Body D 1 features a very close and fast orbit with its parent body, a T class brown dwarf.

records.name: Garnet Raindrops (Bleia Dryoae UV-C c29-52)
records.description: An understated Green Gas Giant with beige and dark red colours.

records.name: Maxwell's Expanse (Drootiae JC-U d3-7)
records.description: This giant 95 body system offers stunning views, as well as plentiful pristine tritium reserves for fleet carriers.

records.name: Susano'o Planetary Nebula and E03-type Anomalies (Phleedgaa UJ-Q e5-185)
records.description: A planetary nebula with stormy clouds and E03-type Anomalies, in 100 ly around the system.

records.name: Flux Horizon (Syritchou FV-P d5-7)
records.description: Moon BC 3 b is an icy world with a landable oxygen atmosphere that has a steep orbital inclination around its parent gas giant. The gas giant itself has a wide ring system 1.2 million km in radius.

records.name: Shimmersilk Planetary Nebula (Teqaea PT-Q e5-860)
records.description: A vibrant teal planetary nebula containing an Earth-like world.

records.name: Vegnue AA-A h17 Nebula (Tsukuyomi's Wings Nebula) (Vegnue PY-M b51-4)
records.description: A large nebula with Parasol Molluscs in the Notable Stellar Phenomena signals around it.

records.name: Strawberry Сake (Boelts XH-C c29-854)
records.description: A Class II Green Gas Giant with thin clouds of pink and green across equatorial regions.

records.name: Islands in the Sea (Blaa Hype TF-V d3-144)
records.description: A Class III Green Gas Giant that's mostly blue, and as similar to other Green Gas Giants as it gets.

records.name: Giant Welcome (Bludgu DB-W c15-0)
records.description: A class V gas giant in a very close orbit around an M type star, easily visible right after arriving in the system.

records.name: Jackson's Lighthouse (Jackson's Lighthouse)
records.description: The closest primary neutron star to Sol. A great location to learn how to supercharge your FSD.

records.name: Newton's Harp (Dryuae Auscs CF-O c7-1848)
records.description: A shepherd moon of a gas giant that orbits close to its parent's rings, the distance from the surface to the rings is 122 kilometers.

records.name: The Odd Triple (Dryeae Aod RR-W d1-55)
records.description: An unlikely ternary system with wildly varying axial tilts.

records.name: Oread's Realm (Cryaa Ain ZJ-R e4-4)
records.description: The highest Green Gas Giant above the galactic plane, with tiny spots of green.

records.name: The Seducer (Oofaih VE-G d11-16)
records.description: A rare ringed landable thin helium-rich atmosphere planet, with more light to see by than is usual on such worlds.

records.name: Beta Hydri (Beta Hydri)
records.description: Beta Hydri is a permit locked system that was one of the founding members of the Federation.

records.name: 13 Mu Sagittarii (13 Mu Sagittarii)
records.description: A blue-white B Class Supergiant with close landable bodies, and one of the most distant stars visible from Earth with the naked eye.

records.name: Kataraktis Nefon (HD 78344)
records.description: The closest ringed neutron star to the bubble.

records.name: Shepherd's Pasture (Droeth MA-A d83)
records.description: A shepherd moon that is only 84 kilometers from its surface to its parent's rings.

records.name: Janssen's Mines (Prie Brai WW-W b1-3)
records.description: A resource-rich system containing two Helium-Rich Gas Giants with Tritium hotspots.

records.name: Quartet's Tiny Secret (Dryooe Priae JM-C d19)
records.description: An Ammonia moon that, along with its parent High Metal Content Planet, orbits four stars in a double binary system.

records.name: Thermal Skew (Blooe Phoe LD-A d14-2)
records.description: A "hot Jupiter" that's only 1.5 ls from its parent star, with a rapid orbit, and a surface temperature that's 2.5 times higher than its parent's.

records.name: Betelgeuse (Betelgeuse)
records.description: Betelgeuse is a red supergiant star 498 light-years away from Earth. If our own Sun were the same size, its surface would be beyond the orbit of Mars.

records.name: Celtic Muse (Myoangeia RN-T d3-59)
records.description: A beautiful wide ring around this Class I Gas Giant, with two shepherd moons.

records.name: Kokytos (Teqia VL-K d9-11)
records.description: The surface of the 6 a moon is only 130 km away from the metal-rich ring of its Helium-Rich Gas Giant parent.

records.name: Delphi (Delphi)
records.description: A significant human controlled system in the Merope bubble that also hosts an active Thargoid surface site.

records.name: Order in the Heavens (Eoch Pruae JS-R d5-2055)
records.description: Binary Earth-Like Worlds with a tourist beacon, and two water worlds present in system.

records.name: Icarus's Descent (Syralaei ED-Q d6-2)
records.description: A small Metal-Rich World in a death spiral around a White Dwarf star.

records.name: Leda's Daughters (Myoangeia RN-T d3-39)
records.description: Two similarly-sized class I gas giants, one orbiting the other with a wide ring.

records.name: Mithras's Rest (Myoangeia RN-T d3-91)
records.description: A nested moon orbits a blue marble-looking water world capped with an ice cap, which in turn orbits a class Y dwarf star.

records.name: Infinity Canyons (Greae Phio GH-V b47-2)
records.description: B 3 a is a small moon with a surface completely covered with canyons, closely orbiting its parent with a 4.7 hour orbit.

records.name: Amethyst Kaminari Planetary Nebula (Wepue AA-Z e1744)
records.description: Planetary nebula with only a black hole, the only illumination being the nebula glow. Has Electricae Radialem on the surface of one planet.

records.name: Four Strings (Ootosps UR-H d11-17)
records.description: An extreme rarity: four Earth-like worlds, in three different orbital configurations.

records.name: Canonn Crater (Pleiades Sector JC-U b3-2)
records.description: A tourist beacon marking a large crater which contains five Thargoid Barnacles.

records.name: Ellaisms Remnant (Ellaisms QX-U e2-43)
records.description: A small blue planetary nebula lit by a neutron star, with rare and dangerous P02-Type Anomalies in the rings of the first planet.

records.name: Caoilte the Fianna (Syraumaei LB-X c4-3)
records.description: A fast-orbiting moon providing stunning stellar vistas.

records.name: Rusty Net Planetary Nebula (Skaude AL-X e1-28)
records.description: A visually striking planetary nebula along the Colonia Connection Highway

records.name: Skull and Crossbones Nebula (Haffner 18 LSS 27)
records.description: The lonely nebula of the South-East, with many catalogue systems around it.

records.name: Minotaur's Treasure (Byoomao JC-B d1-3681)
records.description: A Class III Green Gas Giant with deep red clouds and small patches of magenta and green near the equator.

records.name: Ringed Brothers (Scheau Blou MX-A d1-113)
records.description: A system with a ringed Earth-like world closely orbiting three ringed gas giants.

records.name: Yellow Fever (Umbaiss OT-Q e5-1308)
records.description: Yellow craters giving nice views of a moon's close orbiting parent.

records.name: Ciel's Dual Ring (Phroea Gree AA-A h45)
records.description: This triple Black Hole system is home to a rare double-ringed M dwarf star. Both rings are visible to the eye.

records.name: Mitterand Hollow (Epsilon Indi)
records.description: One of the great wonders of the galaxy, Mitterand Hollow orbits New Africa every 86.4 seconds.

records.name: Shepherd of the South (Lyed MS-B d13-0)
records.description: A shepherd moon along the path to Amundsen's Star offers spectacular views of its parent planet's metal-rich ring. Its position makes it likely the southernmost shepherd moon in the Milky Way.

records.name: Autumn Evening (Phoi Bro PM-D c15-0)
records.description: A system with an atmospheric rocky planet, orbiting a highly inclined class III gas giant. Body 2 c features remarkable surface sights from its carbon dioxide atmosphere, and 7 biological signals.

records.name: Summer Holiday (Greethaei BS-J d9-40)
records.description: A system with an atmospheric rocky ice planet, orbiting a highly inclined helium-rich gas giant. Body 5 b features remarkable surface sights from its oxygen atmosphere.

records.name: Ice Flows (Crookooe JR-N c6-1)
records.description: Nice views on 2 b and 2 a, which both orbit a ringed gas giant, with 2 a being close to the rings of the giant and 2 b having plenty of geological activity.

records.name: Two Rocks One Ring (Ciesau AA-A e82)
records.description: A rocky binary orbiting close to the rings of its gas giant parent.

records.name: Sulphuric Sisters of Systimbau (Systimbau UF-E d12-8416)
records.description: A close pair of rocky moons, one of them with a thick sulphur dioxide atmosphere.

records.name: Lockyer's Delight (Splojio KS-S d4-492)
records.description: A system with an abundance of helium, featuring several Helium-Rich Gas Giants and a landable planet with a thin helium atmosphere.

records.name: Vaporous Neighbours (Phleedgoea ZF-Q b37-8)
records.description: A system with both a Water World and an Ammonia World under 100 ls from arrival. The Ammonia World has a close landable atmospheric moon orbiting only 0.36 ls away.

records.name: Spirograph Nebula (BD-12 1172)
records.description: The Spirograph Nebula is a planetary nebula 1,100 light-years from Sol, in the direction of Barnard's Loop and the Orion Nebula. It has strong cyan-green colors.

records.name: The Witch's Pools (Synuefe PB-G c13-5)
records.description: This system about 250 light-years from the Witch Head Nebula features multiple water worlds, multiple Notable Stellar Phenomena, and four atmospheric moons with life.

records.name: Witch Head Nebula (HIP 23759)
records.description: One of the closest nebulae to Sol, and rich in history.

records.name: The Gingerbread Trio (Aucosly TI-T e3-0)
records.description: A helium-rich system with two sets of trinary orbital configurations, both having a landable ringed planet.

records.name: Arcane Allure (Boelts QJ-Y d1-1149)
records.description: A ringed Green Gas Giant with Water-Based Life in a triple planetary configuration, right on the route between Colonia and the Bubble.

records.name: Virescent Wonder (Thaileia PJ-O d7-74)
records.description: A vibrant Green Gas Giant with Water-Based Life around 4,700 light-years from Sol, sitting along the route to Sagittarius A*.

records.name: Treacherous Tango (Struqeou ZU-Y f1000)
records.description: A black hole and four white dwarf stars, with an assortment of planets orbiting various ones.

records.name: Cerberus' Gateway (Eorl Bru YJ-A f80)
records.description: Two neutron stars orbiting each other closely, in a system with a black hole and four neutron stars.

records.name: Halcyon's Halo (Phleedgaa CH-B d14-662)
records.description: A water giant hosting a massive 15 million kilometer wide icy ring system. A gas giant orbits the planet from afar with landable moons for magnificent sights.

records.name: Dragon's Garden (Crookaae XE-O d7-56)
records.description: A system home to more than a dozen species of exoflora, with ten families of plants on the 8 f moon.

records.name: Riddle's Montes (Hypi Aoscs FG-Y d655)
records.description: The A 5 c moon houses a tall and massive mountain range, which stands like a mohawk in comparison to the surrounding landscape, with gorgeous overlooks and great shadows.

records.name: Phoenix Twins (Pheia Auscs XU-X d1-355)
records.description: Seemingly unremarkable system offers magnificent views of a nearby nebula, which lights up the sky of the single landable planetary body.

records.name: Lost Ring River (Athaiwyg NQ-W b5-1)
records.description: A small moon (6 a) close to a gas giant's rings (744 km away), on a fast orbit.

records.name: Dioscuri Blue (Dryoi Bli OS-U f2-349)
records.description: A Class V gas giant that orbits a white dwarf in 0.5 light-seconds distance and has an orbital period of 26 minutes. There is a landable planet 15 light-seconds away to watch the close pair from afar.

records.name: Gwydion's Crown (Gongue NR-C d0)
records.description: A spectacular gas giant with three landable shepherd moons, and a fourth with an eccentric orbit.

records.name: The Dryad's Garden (Graea Hypue WF-W d2-92)
records.description: A water world moon of a brown dwarf star, with a landable nested moon just 0.031 ls away. The moon offers a close look to the clouds, and hosts some brain trees.

records.name: Brain Flow (Graea Hypue SE-X d2-666)
records.description: A thin argon atmospheric high metal content world with rings, and Brain Trees on the surface.

records.name: Brain Ocean (Graea Hypue MC-C d65)
records.description: A thin water-rich atmospheric ringed moon that hosts Brain Trees.

records.name: Icarus' Rest (Yaikiae WP-V d3-3)
records.description: A Water World on an eccentric orbit, a landable planet near a star, and some Notable Stellar Phenomena.

records.name: Aurantius Oriole (Thraikou VZ-P e5-4)
records.description: This system hosts a red dwarf with a ring, as well as 4 non atmospheric planets with biological signs. It features an orbiting body with a 180° view of the rings of the star.

records.name: Devil's Maw (Graea Hypue LA-X b18-0)
records.description: A deep canyon with steep walls that lies between two mountain ranges with high geological activity all around.

records.name: Ice Wheel (Graea Hypue CO-M b38-16)
records.description: An icy moon with an orbital inclination of over 39 degrees orbiting of a ringed gas giant.

records.name: Dark Outlier (Graea Hypue AW-L b11-6)
records.description: An icy moon orbiting closely and almost perpendicular to it's parent's rings.

records.name: Invictus Mons (Nuekau JS-I d10-978)
records.description: A mountain towering 8.95 km tall over a wide desert, clearly visible from space.

records.name: Scylla's Sanctum (Ciesuae AA-A g159)
records.description: A neutron star and a white dwarf can be viewed through the wide rings of a brown dwarf star (DE 2), from a landable moon on a highly inclined orbit.

records.name: Rings of Lyra (Graea Hypue EW-U d3-276)
records.description: A rare Gas Giant with three rings, which can be observed from a nearby atmospheric, landable moon.

records.name: Horseman's Fiery Reins (Zunuae QZ-O e6-7723)
records.description: Twin neutron stars in a close orbit, only 1 ls apart.

records.name: Glorious Nebula, the Tourist Trap (Hen 2-23)
records.description: A planetary nebula around a Wolf-Rayet star, with a Tourist Beacon which was for some time an infamous destination, one that explorers would warn others about.

records.name: Achenar's Scion (Cyoidai OD-N c9-5)
records.description: Trinary orbiting Earth-like worlds around a class K star. They are orbiting fairly close from one another and can be faintly spotted around each other.

records.name: The Outland Worlds (Juenae LZ-C c1-7640)
records.description: A binary pair of Earth-like worlds in the heart of a cluster of over 200 ELWs.

records.name: Kepler's Fantasy (Byua Aoscs PJ-E b2)
records.description: A planet of a binary pair that has not only incredibly narrow Taylor rings, but also a total of four moons (rare in this configuration): two in a binary pair, and the fourth with an inclined orbit.

records.name: Luyten's Gardens (Vegnoea QI-B e1)
records.description: An unusual system hosting a series of rare White Dwarf related organic species.

records.name: Mystic Moon (Graea Hypue AF-O b10-15)
records.description: An icy moon orbiting a gas giant in under 22 hours, on a highly inclined orbit.

records.name: Nightly Ring (Blu Schoe ZW-A c14-0)
records.description: An icy moon with an inclined orbit, offering nice views of the huge ring of its gas giant parent.

records.name: Tyrian Sky (Graea Hypue WG-K d9-275)
records.description: A ringed moon of a gas giant with a highly inclined and close orbit.

records.name: Helgrind (Blu Schoe KL-Y d1)
records.description: A landable metal-rich moon in a binary pair with a ringed hellish red-glowing metal-rich world.

records.name: Kari and Beli (Blu Schoe HY-Z d13-0)
records.description: A close binary pair of gas giants high above the galactic plane, guaranteeing beautiful views.

records.name: Gergovie (Systimbu RZ-O e6-5168)
records.description: The 8 b a nested moon has a close and quick orbit, only 5.1 hours. At this speed, it's quick enough that its motion is visible with the naked eye, from the surface of its parent body.

records.name: A Feisty Depot (Aiphaisty YE-A d130)
records.description: The only known location of Q07-Type Anomalies.

records.name: Life's Portrait (Graea Hypue AM-U d3-82)
records.description: An icy moon (A 2 c) on an inclined orbit around a gas giant, with Brain Trees and Recepta Deltahedronix on its surface.

records.name: Magellan's Star (Ood Fleau ZJ-I d9-0)
records.description: The only system known to house L08-type Anomalies, and also the Easternmost reachable system.

records.name: Hydra's Chakram (chi Hydrae)
records.description: Body A 8 in this system stands out with its large rings, which from a distance makes it look like the body is missing.

records.name: The Eye of Shiva Planetary Nebula (Iowhail KR-W e1-546)
records.description: A planetary nebula, with a black hole as its remnant star.

records.name: Blossoming Siblings (Blua Eoq JT-A c1-1)
records.description: Two binary moons of a gas giant, with a rare combination: thin methane atmospheres and diverse life.

records.name: Vulcan's Brain planetary nebula (Lyruelks FL-P e5-41)
records.description: This pulsar wind planetary nebula in the Vulcan Gate region features a fast-spinning neutron star and two main sequence companions.

records.name: Vulcan Botanical Gardens (Stueloea PE-E d13-97)
records.description: This system in Vulcan Gate contains 33 exoflora, including three bodies with eight or more species each.

records.name: TriVista Celestia (Thraike GS-B d13-3)
records.description: Trinary barycentric planets close to their host star, two of which have atmospheres, geoactivity and bacterial life

records.name: Graveyard Ghosts (Wepaa BA-A g1735)
records.description: Seven types of Anomalies around black holes within 500 ly of this system: the largest and most diverse Anomaly-area in the galaxy.

records.name: Pistachio Raceways (Hedgau WU-E c12-0)
records.description: Extremely well defined canyons that are perfect for racing events or for enjoying the scenery, on body 4 a.

records.name: Crystal Alley (Ploea Brou NO-A b14-11)
records.description: A tour of three NSP signals containing Rubeum Squid Molluscs, with four types of crystals in total. The rings of the third planet contain five tritium hotspots.

records.name: Tater Salad (Sleguae NA-H c13-22)
records.description: Two small rocky ice moons in close orbit, around a Class III Gas Giant.

records.name: Pythia's Chasm of Prophecy (Phroi Pruae AA-A h250)
records.description: Nested moon 1 b a orbits an Ammonia World at only 0.037 ls, with an orbital period of 5 hours, and a ringed icy moon (3 h) contains rare Fonticulua Segmentatus.

records.name: Traikeou Goliaths (Traikeou AA-A h4)
records.description: A binary star system consisting of two extraordinarily bright stars, a Wolf-Rayet and a blue-white supergiant.

records.name: Two Pair Stare (Dehue WV-M d7-27)
records.description: A system with two pairs of binary A type and G type stars orbiting extremely close to one another.

records.name: The Wall of Asgard (Cheia Drye RU-V d3-2)
records.description: Spectacular sheer cliffs on a landable rocky world.

records.name: Ben Uaine (Phaa Ain GG-N d7-29)
records.description: A tall mountain rising 8.4 km above the vast valley floor below, Ben Uaine gets its name from its vibrant green colour contrasted with the Martian-like orange of its surroundings.

records.name: Dark Tides (Schee Prau AA-A h230)
records.description: A binary pair of a water world and a gas giant orbiting 9 ls from two black holes and a ringed white dwarf.
