records.name: The Quadrumvirate of Thebes (Greou Eaescs XP-U c4-5)
records.description: A system redolent with four Ammonia Worlds, a rare record shared with only a handful of other systems.

records.name: Photographer's Dream (Eulain AA-A h49)
records.description: A red giant star with an Earth-like moon of a brown star, an Ammonia world, an Oxygen Atmosphere with strange anomalies, and a number of atmospheric planets.

records.name: Aurora Aqua (Eorl Scrua AA-A h484)
records.description: A ringed White Dwarf star, orbited closely by a binary pair of a Water World and a landable atmospheric rocky body, also in a binary orbit with an M class star.

records.name: Aisunaifu (Schee Eaec DY-C b5-0)
records.description: A gas giant with a moon so close to the rings that they enter the moons orbital cruise zone, offering stunning views from the surface and curious gravitational effects from orbit.

records.name: Thaumas's Kingdom (Myrielk DW-N d6-2223)
records.description: Four Water World moons close orbit a gas giant (and there are five total WWs in the system), two of them are ringed, and the other two are a binary pair.

records.name: Guardian Of The Twins (Byae Aowsy GR-N d6-52)
records.description: The DSSA fleet carrier, Miskatonic University, is stationed near the rings of a beautiful Earth-like World that orbits binary class III gas giants.

records.name: Hiraeth Triplet (Systae Free AF-A d13)
records.description: Three Earth-like worlds in a system that's 2,600 ly above the galactic plane.

records.name: Hachiman's Squish (Phipaa GX-K c8-11)
records.description: A non-landable nested moon orbits its parent moon at close proximity, rotating fast enough for it to be visibly oblate.

records.name: The Song of Ice, Fire and Gamma Rays (Oochosy ES-B d13-1)
records.description: A massive and hot icy world that orbits around its parent white dwarf star closely, sometimes going through the edge of its jet, only 4,400 ly from the bubble.

records.name: Red Dominance (Wepooe JZ-X c2-1463)
records.description: A landable metal-rich world orbits a class L brown dwarf star at a distance between 1.14 - 1.55 ls. The star dominates the sky from the planet's surface.

records.name: No Name - Invalid Destination (Elephant's Trunk Sector XO-A c1)
records.description: A malfunctioning tourist beacon.

records.name: Traikeou AA-A h2 Nebula (Blood Rose Nebula) (Traikeou BP-F b28-0)
records.description: A larger nebula hosting Purpureum Gourd Molluscs, not far from the Sol-Colonia route.

records.name: Three of a Kind (Phoo Scroi AA-A h3)
records.description: A rare configuration of three stars orbiting a black hole binary pair: a binary pair of a ringed neutron star and a class A star, and also a K class orange giant star.

records.name: Astral Dynamo (Oudaitt AA-A g33)
records.description: A Class V Gas Giant orbits a White Dwarf at a distance of 0.45 ls, completing an orbit in just under 19 minutes.

records.name: Amaryllis Veil (Eok Bluae AE-T d3-2290)
records.description: A pink gas giant only 7 ly from a nearby planetary nebula. When framed correctly, the nebula appears to explode outwards from the planet.

records.name: Eden's Misty Gem (Braisoo HD-Q d6-11)
records.description: A ringed Class II Green Gas Giant with several thin clouds of pink and green. A variety of landable bodies, with all surface materials present in the system.

records.name: Sulfur Drift (Iorady AC-D d12-0)
records.description: A scenic landing site for expedition meet-ups and surface activities in the far North of the Galaxy, near Beagle Point and the Northern Meridian.

records.name: Vortex of Selene (Ploi Aeg GL-V c16-0)
records.description: A brown Dwarf with large rings, 53 ls from the main star, with nice views of the galaxy from 1,500 ly above the plane.

records.name: Vesperi Circulum (Dumbaei ZX-X c28-14)
records.description: An atmospheric ringed icy moon on an inclined orbit around a gas giant that has extremely wide rings, and six shepherd moons.

records.name: Three and a Crown (Eol Prou AA-A h112)
records.description: A partially explored massive system 176 ly from Colonia. Notable for its trinary black holes and a rare Taylor's Ring around a gas giant.

records.name: The Grotto of Amethystos (Plua Chruia LG-Y d15)
records.description: A beautiful fine ringed ammonia world with Albidum Chalice Pods, Purpureum and Roseum Ice Crystals.

records.name: Chiron's Tail (Oofaich ZR-H d11-3)
records.description: A hot thin sulfur dioxide landable body on a close (4.74 ls) and fast (0.6 days) orbit around a white dwarf star.

records.name: Lantern of Oephaik (Oephaik WF-M d8-2236)
records.description: A rare Hot Thin Silicate Vapour atmosphere landable body, with a class M red dwarf star dominating its sky.

records.name: Surtr's Crucible (Eoch Pruae JS-R d5-1085)
records.description: A very rare landable thin Silicate Vapour planet, with a class G yellow-orange star covering much of its sky.

records.name: Vulcan's Legend (Eoch Pruae YI-M b26-10)
records.description: Two thin atmospheric High Metal Content worlds that are 8 ls away from a luminous L brown dwarf star.

records.name: Snow White and the Five Dwarves (Eoch Pruae MM-W e1-1768)
records.description: A pair of a white dwarf and a red dwarf in close proximity pair, with a thin atmospheric landable planet, and four non-atmospheric landables.

records.name: Aquila's Enclave (Shaukaae QS-U d2-0)
records.description: An extremely remote Earth-Like World, situated at the end of the Scutum-Centaurus Arm of the galaxy.

records.name: Scylla and Charybdis (Phrooe Blou AA-A h62)
records.description: A pair of ringed neutron stars, one fully lit and the other in darkness.

records.name: Gate of Aetherius (Eoch Flyuae AB-W d2-315)
records.description: A ringed icy moon of a gas giant, with a thin argon atmosphere.

records.name: Maledictus Luna (Dryu Chraea FH-D d12-49)
records.description: The only known location for Q01-Type Anomalies, and a "cursed moon" of the Mercury 7 Expedition.

records.name: Shepherd’s Haven (Gru Drye LX-A d1-41)
records.description: A landable shepherd moon situated only 155 kilometers from its surface to the rings of the gas giant.

records.name: Asterius (Flyoo Groa XW-W c4-13)
records.description: One of only two systems hosting Stolon Trees and their pods, with scenic views of the nearby (10 ly) nebula. It also contains a body with Crystalline Shards yielding Antimony.

records.name: Campana Aurora (Skaudai YP-O e6-17)
records.description: The only known system where you can find Gypseeum Bell Mollusc inside different coloured Lagrange clouds.

records.name: Eyes of Argus (Dryooe Groa QX-F c16)
records.description: A Green Gas Giant displaying storms of dark red tinged with green.

records.name: Kashyapa, Vihara Gate (Kashyapa)
records.description: One of the inhabited systems along the Sol - Colonia route, with an Ocellus station around a ringed Earth-like world. No shipyards.

records.name: Gandharvi, Marlin's Reach and Caravanserai (Gandharvi)
records.description: One of the inhabited systems along the Sol - Colonia route, housing an Ocellus station with a shipyard.

records.name: Ringed Paradise (Throets AA-A h500)
records.description: Twelve ringed bodies in this system, including two ringed class M red dwarf stars that have multiple bodies nearby which make for great views.

records.name: Eastern Crowns (Plae Broae SO-R c4-0)
records.description: A ringed moon orbiting a ringed gas giant on a highly inclined orbit (-87 degrees), with the giant's rings covering a large part of the sky when viewed from the moon's surface.

records.name: Starlit Dreamscape (Hypua Pruae ZR-H d11-59)
records.description: A landable oxygen atmosphere planet orbiting a ringed class Y brown dwarf star on a highly inclined orbit (88 degrees), with the rings covering a large part of the sky when viewed from the surface.

records.name: The White Crown (Umbaiss AA-A h641)
records.description: A ringed white dwarf star in a binary orbit with an M class red dwarf star. It has multiple bodies nearby for sightseeing including a landable body with volcanism close to the ringed white dwarf.

records.name: Eden in Oephaird (Oephaird CF-A e7699)
records.description: An extreme rarity: an Earth-like moon that's inside a planetary nebula. As of 3310, only three such bodies are known.

records.name: Dawn of Harmony (Dryau Scraa AA-A h616)
records.description: A ringed White dwarf star with a set of trinary moons and an Earth-like world with a closely orbiting nested moon. Elsewhere in the system, a wide-ringed class K orange star.

records.name: Xochitli's Rest (Wembaei UM-A b57-4)
records.description: A blue Class III Green Gas Giant with specks of green.

records.name: The Sinking Ship (Nyeajaae XW-I d10-42)
records.description: A Class IV gas giant with a wide ring: 109.50 ls / 32,826,600 km. It features a ringed gas giant moon on an inclined orbit.

records.name: Dance of the Tides (Plua Eun HV-Y d0)
records.description: A landable nested moon closely orbiting a water world moon.

records.name: Odin's Wreath (Scaulou XK-O e6-4974)
records.description: A red dwarf star with a 30,056,000 km wide Metal-Rich ring, orbited by a nearby landable moon.

records.name: Atmo Aqua (Dryi Chrea MS-T e3-219)
records.description: The biggest ringed landable body (as of Dec. 3310) and the third biggest landable with thin atmosphere.

records.name: Grand Gulliver (Phoo Chreou PX-L d7-61)
records.description: This planet holds the current galactic record (as of 3310-12-11) for the largest landable thin atmospheric body, with a diameter of 28,744 km.

records.name: Hear no evil, See no evil, Speak no evil (Lyrongou SO-R e4-407)
records.description: A trio of two neutron stars and a white dwarf, each of them close to the others.

records.name: The Plunging World (Scheau Prao OS-U f2-448)
records.description: A landable planet that plunges extremely close to the white dwarf star that it orbits. Its highly eccentric orbits makes it easy to land on when it's farther away from the star.

records.name: Aeon’s Halo (Blua Eaec WB-B d14-317)
records.description: A trinary set of a ringed Earth-like World,a ringed Water World and a Class III gas giant, in a system with 78 bodies.

records.name: Beacon of Radiance (Skaude AA-A h45)
records.description: The third ever discovered ringed F type star, and the only Ringed F type with visible rings. Also the widest and heaviest rings orbiting such a star. Currently bugged.

records.name: Asteria's Augury (Eowyg Ail DR-V d2-0)
records.description: A beautiful Class I green gas giant with vivid green and pink cloud bands.

records.name: Stones from the sky (Schee Hypue IF-A c3-0)
records.description: A satellite (2 a) of a gas giant located so close to its parent's rings that the asteroids can be seen passing by from the moon's surface.

records.name: Research Vessel Cete (Col 173 Sector LJ-F c12-0)
records.description: An abandoned research vessel with logs containining the last records of an expedition sent to find ruins of the extinct Guardians, and a wrecked Anaconda on a less noble mission.

records.name: Xerophyte Homestead (Eodgorks FR-N e6-68)
records.description: Two anaerobic lifeforms on four planets, notably one on a close binary and another on a terraformable ringed thin atmospheric world.

records.name: Tricone Crucible (Eok Blou FG-Y g1252)
records.description: A triple set of jets: a pair of neutron stars in close proximity with a white dwarf star.

records.name: Helios' Passage (Pleia Thaa YE-A g0)
records.description: A moon with an inclined orbit, its surface located just 372 km from the rings of the gas giant.

records.name: Rhea’s Reflection (Flyae Eaewsy MZ-E d12-4)
records.description: A ringed moon with an oxygen atmosphere, orbiting a ringed blue gas giant on a high inclination and at a close distance.

records.name: Fínleiki (Boekh AO-H b27-33)
records.description: An unremarkable Class I Green Gas Giant in a beautiful setting.

records.name: Voyager's Rest (Ooscs Aiq FX-K d8-0)
records.description: A white dwarf star with a desolate atmospheric moon (4 c), well above the Milky Way.

records.name: Xenohenge (Synuefe XR-H d11-102)
records.description: The historic site of the first Guardian Ruins, discovered in 3302.

records.name: Rose's Thorn (Phrio Hype BB-W e2-8)
records.description: A mottled pink Class III Green Gas Giant, with patches of vibrant green clouds in the upper atmosphere.

records.name: Aselou (A Promise of Life) (Pyroifeia KE-E d13-35)
records.description: A gas giant with several life-bearing moons around it, including two Earth-like worlds, one of which is ringed. A tourist beacon is also present here.

records.name: Erebus Eden (Dryaa Blou AA-A g1586)
records.description: Two Earth-Like World moons of a red dwarf star that orbits a black hole.

records.name: Viridian Solitude (Dryooe Flyou XS-Z c14-199)
records.description: A subtle Green Gas Giant, displaying only three small islands of bright green clouds.

records.name: Wreath of Rocks (Dehau EG-Y g9)
records.description: Two stars with rings: a red dwarf and a brown dwarf star. Various bodies and atmospheres around the only ringless star in the system.

records.name: Archer's Apple (Nyuena AC-B d14-245)
records.description: A Class I Green Gas Giant with vivid green and pink swirling clouds. Within the planet's rings are K10-Type Anomalies.

records.name: Serpent's Egg (Eodgorph LM-W e1-167)
records.description: A mostly blue Class III Green Gas Giant exhibiting small green storms.

records.name: Cranberry Bog (Flyiedge KA-V b8-5)
records.description: A beige class I Green Gas Giant with deep maroon coloring at the poles and around the equator, but no discernable green areas.

records.name: Rose Quartz (Blu Thua IS-B c13-6)
records.description: The second planet in this system is a Class II Green Gas Giant, featuring a wide pink equatorial cloud band interspersed with bright green higher altitude clouds.

records.name: Mimir's Inferno (Eitosts TO-O d7-0)
records.description: A landable planet only 4 light seconds away from a white dwarf, moving through its jet several times a day.

records.name: Abyssal Island (Pyrie Thua FF-R d4-1)
records.description: A ringed Water World, orbited by a landable moon with life.

records.name: Cerulean Horizon (Myeia Thaa BU-Q c18-0)
records.description: A landable moon with life, orbiting a ringed gas giant at high orbital inclination, featuring bright blue sunsets dominated by its parent's rings.

records.name: Tales of Might (Phipoea EF-R d4-7856)
records.description: A thin oxygen atmosphere moon on a mighty eccentric orbit around a ringed Class Y dwarf star.

records.name: A Marble's Halo (Agnaiz OR-V d2-376)
records.description: A white gas giant that orbits a brown dwarf star which has a massive ring system.

records.name: Arctic Circles (Byeethaea BA-A c0)
records.description: An icy moon on an inclined orbit that provides nice views of its parent gas giant's prominent icy rings.

records.name: Rán and Jörð (NGC 7380 Sector QW-N b9-3)
records.description: A close binary pair of planets, a Water World and a landable High Metal Content world, orbiting their shared barycenter quite closely.

records.name: Ice Shanty (Hypo Brou MX-L d7-0)
records.description: An icy moon orbiting a gas giant on a highly inclined orbit, almost perpendicular to the gas giant's rings.

records.name: Santa's Domain (Wepua JC-V e2-3480)
records.description: A solitary thin neon-rich atmospheric body inside a planetary nebula.

records.name: Astrometric Observatory (HIP 19187)
records.description: The headquarters and principal observatory for the Electro-Dynamic Astrometric (EDAstro) Scientific Society.

records.name: Palantír (Kyloarph PD-I d10-4719)
records.description: A dark black gas giant, with an impressive ring system contrasting with it.

records.name: Bola Negra (Nyeajaae NF-T b35-2)
records.description: A rocky icy planet with extreme surface temperatures and atmospheric pressure, located close to the Colonia Bridge.

records.name: Earth-like dance with giant (IC 1396 Sector RU-F d11-7)
records.description: Landable moon orbiting an Earth-like moon extremely closely. Tourist beacon also present.

records.name: Einstein's Telescope Array (Wepaa FG-Y g584)
records.description: A black hole close to a planetary nebula, giving spectacular lensing effects, as well as three other similar black holes.

records.name: Raymond's Kiwi (Ploi Thua AY-T b3-0)
records.description: A Green Gas Giant which shows barely any signs of the radioplankton thriving within its clouds, instead retaining its brown color that's distinctive of the Gas Giants with Ammonia-based Life.

records.name: River of Woe Planetary Nebula (Syrivu GG-X e1-0)
records.description: One of the few North-Eastern planetary nebulae, with a Water World inside.

records.name: Herbig's Lantern (Wredgo BQ-Y f0)
records.description: A Class IV Green Gas Giant with vivid bands of green clouds, the first one to be discovered in a proto-star system. Also the youngest, only 2 million years old.

records.name: The Minions of Morpheus Planetary Nebula (Blia Aod QE-Q e5-0)
records.description: A planetary nebula around a black hole system, hosting 79 bodies in total, the majority of which are landable. Surface life is present on some thin atmospheric bodies.

records.name: Nested Wonders (Iowhaidst YK-E c12-3)
records.description: A gas giant with orbited by six Helium-Rich Gas Giants as its moons, with two nested moons that are also landable, with excellent views of the giants from their surfaces.

records.name: A. E. B City (NLTT 10259)
records.description: A large planetary port that completely covers the summit of the mountain it has been built on, making it a popular venue for SRV racing.

records.name: View of Finality (Agnaiz LD-A d14-964)
records.description: A C-N carbon giant star which hosts two close-orbiting gas giants with moons, with the first giant orbiting near the star's corona.

records.name: Graviton Gyre (Umbaists AA-A h133)
records.description: A system which contains 5 black holes and 3 neutron stars.

records.name: Stellar Trinity (Chraisuae WP-X e1-1232)
records.description: Three landable planets (without atmospheres) orbit a common barycenter formed by a neutron star, a white dwarf, and a class G star. The stars also co-orbit with a black hole.

records.name: Sable Verge (Spoihaae JH-U d3-30)
records.description: An Earth-like world orbiting a neutron star approximately 2000 Light-years under the galactic plane.

records.name: Zephyr and Boreas (Syneayoea OP-F d11-0)
records.description: Two moons in a close binary orbit, around a brown dwarf star that orbits an F-type star.

records.name: The Judicator's Reach (Baukoa HP-R c4-2032)
records.description: A system with fast-moving ring structures, hazardous approach zones, and stunning views, between two closely-orbiting Metal-Rich worlds and a small rocky moon passing near one of the rings.

records.name: Egg Brûlée (Eorld Grie DL-Y g34)
records.description: An oblate Class V Gas Giant orbiting a White Dwarf completely inside its exclusion zone, passing through a jet cone every 15 minutes.

records.name: Hávamál's Depths (Wepaa FG-Y g66)
records.description: A ringed M-class red dwarf star around a black hole, with K-05 and K-06 Type Anomalies.

records.name: Goliath's Mirror (Shaulai RD-K d8-55)
records.description: A class IV gas giant with a ring system spanning nearly 50 ls in radius. The rings are easily visible from nearly every location of the system.

records.name: The Celestial Waltz (Schee Flyi BA-A g1093)
records.description: Two binary Black Holes in close orbit with a binary pair of Neutron Stars.

records.name: Witch's Cauldron (Wepue JN-I d10-5146)
records.description: A high valley situated between towering (8.86 km tall) mountains.

records.name: Entropy's Carousel (Myumbe WO-A f1305)
records.description: Five Neutron Stars orbiting a Black Hole.

records.name: The Blue Outsider (Synuefe WG-L a76-1)
records.description: A captured Earth-like world in a low mass system of brown dwarf stars, with a distinct red tint over the planet's surface. Recently colonized.

records.name: Ruby Trio (Nyeajie BQ-S c6-10)
records.description: A landable icy world that completes an orbit around a brown dwarf star in 0.1 days, and two thin atmospheric planets which co-orbit three brown dwarf stars.

records.name: Hades Edge (HD 49368)
records.description: Two ringed planets orbiting close to a giant carbon star, which dominates their skies. Heatsink launchers often required for landing.

records.name: Tark (Blu Thua JS-J d9-1)
records.description: This binary star system less than 2,500 light-years from Sol contains four Earth-like worlds and four water worlds, two of which are terraformable.

records.name: Lich Pulsar (PSR J1300+1240)
records.description: This star system at the ceiling of the galaxy is home to the first three known exoplanets, discovered in 1990.

records.name: Aquatic Octave (Pyriviae NY-Y d1-66)
records.description: A system with eight Water Worlds.

records.name: Statue of Liberty Nebula (Statue of Liberty Sector LC-V c2-12)
records.description: A stellar nursery encompassing dozens of star systems about 6,000 light-years from Earth in the Carina constellation.

records.name: The Bridal Waltz (Synookeou OH-Z b27-0)
records.description: Two ringed landable metal-rich bodies in close binary orbit, 6 ls from their parent star.

records.name: Wisps of the Shadelight (Wepaa AA-A f809)
records.description: Black hole primary system featuring two NSPs containing K-Type Anomalies. One of the NSPs is in a closer orbit of a neutron star.

records.name: Suns of Pamplona (Froagh SS-U e2-2)
records.description: Binary A-class stars orbited by six T-Tauri stars and high-gravity worlds harboring Luteolum Anenomes.

records.name: Tatio Patio (Wredgo YE-R e4-20)
records.description: A landing site with a larger amount of geysers on the 13th planet.

records.name: Six Cradles of Life (Truecheia TS-U d2-106)
records.description: Five Water Worlds and an Ammonia World, with all but one of them orbiting the same star.

records.name: Resilient Hope Planetary Nebula (Schee Bli JX-T e3-4747)
records.description: The only known planetary nebula to have two Earth-like worlds, one of which is a moon.

records.name: LGM-1 pulsar (LGM-1)
records.description: LGM-1 was the first pulsar discovered by astronomers at Cambridge University in 1967.

records.name: Aurelia Valles (Eeshorks XJ-A d89)
records.description: A moon of a gas giant, with a rough and varied terrain, and a thin ammonia atmosphere.

records.name: Matryoshka (Eoch Flyuae YK-K c10-56)
records.description: An unusual system with three bodies that regularly collide, sometimes simultaneously.

records.name: Cthulhu's Slumber (Myumbiae AA-A h3)
records.description: The outermost ring of the neutron star in this system extends nearly 250 light-seconds from its parent body.

records.name: Verdant Maelstrom (Myriesly CL-P e5-7383)
records.description: This planetary nebula and its nearby systems contain a Lagrange storm cloud, numerous Q06-Type Anomalies and a variety of exoflora.

records.name: Arcadia's Shadow (Roedaae JO-G a10-1)
records.description: A storm cloud housing Lividum Bullet Molluscs, the first such NSP in this galactic region.

records.name: Caelum Roseus (Truechuae DR-D d12-20)
records.description: Body 7 f is a ringed, atmospheric landable icy body in orbit of a ringed gas giant. The atmosphere is 100% oxygen, which provides stunning pink highlights on the terminator line.

records.name: Zeus's Table Saw (Glaichoo NH-Y c28-1)
records.description: A narrow ring gap with a high rotational velocity difference between the rings. CMDRs are able to watch both rings orbit at different velocities.

records.name: Chroan Crystal Reefs (Preae Chroa LP-A b55-9)
records.description: A ringed gas giant with two Notable Stellar Phenomena points of interest. CMDRs can find 4 out of 6 ice crystal types for this sector here.

records.name: Hyperion's Girdle (Pyriveae AD-H d11-45)
records.description: A gas giant with rings so wide that they cannot be scanned. Two of its moons orbit inside the ring's circumference and one outside.

records.name: Rings of Enlil (Myoangooe RD-A d1-8)
records.description: A huge ring system on ABCD 2, with the outer ring stretching out to 43.18 ls. Six shepherd moons inside the gap, and a gas giant moon outside.

records.name: Adynaton (Eephaills BA-A g100)
records.description: A strange orbital configuration where a T Tauri star is directly orbiting a Class III Gas Giant as its moon, despite being much heavier than its parent.

records.name: The Ringflow (Truechiae UP-G d10-42)
records.description: From the surface of the 1 a moon, the ring system of its brown dwarf star parent can be seen drifting across the sky.

records.name: Gaze of the Blue (Nyauthou WO-Z e1)
records.description: Roseum bioluminescent anemones grow on the one planet in this trinary system of luminous stars.

records.name: Darkest Gardens (Vuchaae NC-V d2-0)
records.description: A lonely and isolated system that hosts some of the galaxy's rarest flora, lit by a white dwarf star.

records.name: The Semaphore (Pyra Dryoae QK-M d8-4)
records.description: Albidum Chalice Pods drift among fields of Rubeum and Prasinum Ice Crystals, creating red and green light shows reminiscent of the ancient communication devices of Earth called the Semaphore.

records.name: Dragonfly Planetary Nebula (Eoch Flyuae UU-O e6-2971)
records.description: A colourful nebula with a high mass neutron star as its heart.

records.name: Ilmarinen Creeks (Skuequ JE-N b54-0)
records.description: A small high metal content world (C 2) covered with canyons. The three stars present in the system and the Milky Way in the background offer some beautiful panoramas, especially at dawn or dusk.

records.name: Giant Blue Rising (Thuechaei AF-Y d1-11)
records.description: An Earth-like moon with a nested moon of its own that's landable, with the Earth-like covering a large part of its sky.

records.name: Sash of Sapphires (Juenoea JN-J d9-7667)
records.description: Body AB 5 is a Class II Green Gas Giant with a hazy pink equatorial cloud band that has bright green storms scattered within.

records.name: A Slingshot and a Handful of Pebbles (Blaea Free EV-G d10-17)
records.description: Tiny metal-rich moons orbiting a nearby gas giant.

records.name: Velvet Inferno (Preou Free MY-Q c18-6)
records.description: A close orbit planet (C 1) around a brown dwarf star, which covers much of its sky. A nearby red dwarf star is also well visible.

records.name: Where Moons Wear Crowns (Bleethea YD-K c11-18)
records.description: A gas giant with six ringed moons, five of which are smaller gas giants.

records.name: Halo of Ubar (Aochou RZ-M d8-3)
records.description: The third ever discovered ringed Thin Ammonia atmosphere planet, as of 3312/03/16.

records.name: New Eden Project (Eok Blao YA-F d11-170)
records.description: New Eden is a deep-space carrier community boasting two ELWs, two Water Worlds, and a neutron star in this system. EDEN fleet carriers provide tritium sales and RRR services to passing explorers.

records.name: Rainbow's End (Roefoo ZE-H d10-0)
records.description: A small scientific hub in a sparse area, the farthest inhabited system from Sol.

records.name: Turquoise Tranquility (Ooctarn KR-Y b41-0)
records.description: An icy body (4) with a thin Nitrogen atmosphere, with Fonticulua Lapida across turquoise plains.

records.name: Pioneer’s Haven (Prie Aod EE-I c26-0)
records.description: A system with Crystalline Shards, all materials for FSD boost synthesis, and peduncle tree and pod NSPs.

records.name: Crimson Veil (Byeethao DN-A d14-3)
records.description: Peduncle pods and trees, in a red Lagrange cloud.

records.name: Lovers' Landmark (Goorea DC-J d10-2)
records.description: Peduncle Trees and Pods in Notable Stellar Phenomena. Beautiful ringed gas giants, a ringed water world.

records.name: The Dead Three (Floarps JM-W f1-648)
records.description: Black Hole system with a Neutron Star and a White Dwarf in close proximity.

records.name: Jotun of Nidavellir (Phrae Bluae JH-M d7-6)
records.description: A Class V gas giant in a tight, eccentric orbit inside a white dwarf’s exclusion zone, passing through its jet cones twice every orbit.

records.name: Mizar's Lapis Rings (Spasau NA-C d14-46)
records.description: A ringed Earth-like world in a binary orbit with a ringed gas giant.

records.name: Alzumarud (Aemonz UT-R d4-36)
records.description: The first known green gas giant with water-based life that's a moon of a T-Tauri star. There also K10-Type Anomalies within its rings.

records.name: Jötunheimr (Flyoo Prau FJ-Y c2-1)
records.description: A ringed icy moon that's relatively close to a ringed gas giant.

records.name: Amphorae of Phlegethon (Flya Flyao RK-D d13-5)
records.description: A pair of planets close to their star, with fumaroles, geysers, and the rare Amphora plants on their surfaces.

records.name: Breathing Water (Yoqeia LX-B d42)
records.description: A system with eight thin water atmospheric bodies orbiting a gas giant, seven of which are landable.

records.name: Gate of Niflheim (Eord Byio AA-A h504)
records.description: Two gas giants in close proximity to each other, and a small icy body with extreme mountains.

records.name: Project Galtea Hub Delta (NGC 6357 Sector BQ-Y d146)
records.description: Project Galtea's fourth Super Supply System, supplying Tritium and construction commodities.

records.name: Project Galtea Hub Gamma (Cat's Paw Sector GW-W c1-9)
records.description: Project Galtea's third Super Supply System, supplying Tritium and construction commodities.

records.name: Project Galtea Hub Beta (Tr 24 Sector QH-U b32-2)
records.description: Project Galtea's second Super Supply System, supplying Tritium and construction commodities.

records.name: Project Galtea Hub Alpha (Bleia Eohn QT-O d7-10)
records.description: Project Galtea's first Super Supply System, supplying Tritium and construction commodities.

records.name: Flamma Gasea (Phrua Flyuae BO-E c13-4)
records.description: A Class V Gas Giant orbiting an M star at 3 ls

records.name: Ryker's Legend (Phroi Byoe HQ-X d1-202)
records.description: A beautiful ringed icy moon (1 b) with a thin argon atmosphere orbiting a triple ringed Class III gas giant, with surface life and volcanism.

records.name: Argent Vulcan (Nyuenoea FA-A e2004)
records.description: One of two landable thin Silicate Vapour atmosphere planets orbiting a supergiant star, with life on the surface.

records.name: Heliopyre (Flyua Hypue SP-M d8-7)
records.description: An extremely rare Ringed Silicate Vapour atmosphere landable planet in a close binary with a huge ringed high metal content world.

records.name: Neutron's Veil (Hypio Flyai PO-F d12-13)
records.description: A landable Metal-rich body in a circumbinary orbit around a neutron star and a class M star, close enough to provide stunning views of the jets.

records.name: Shroud of Nephele (Pro Aec MY-Z d13-103)
records.description: A curious atmospheric phenomenon where the moon's atmosphere becomes a deep blue fog when the closely orbiting nested moon eclipses the star.

records.name: Gobannos & Brigantia Highways (Kyloagy HY-R b24-132)
records.description: A pair of high metal content worlds with very thin rings, orbiting extremely close to each other.

records.name: Scarlet Tempest (Shrogeau GG-Y e119)
records.description: A blue planetary nebula hosting a Lagrange Storm Cloud and P03-type Anomalies.

records.name: Roulette's Cloud (Egnairs RK-N d7-21)
records.description: A White Dwarf system with five gas giants that appear mostly black against the bright background of the galactic glow, coupled with large Red Electricae Pluma on body 3 d.

records.name: Shimmer Sky (Eor Aoc NF-T c18-89)
records.description: A ringed icy moon with a thin argon atmosphere, around a ringed gas giant.

records.name: Orbe de Jade (Myrielk ZC-Z c27-6139)
records.description: Two moons with thin methane atmospheres, relatively close to each other, where solar eclipses occur frequently.

records.name: Helios Gemini K (Byoomu OM-W e1-3850)
records.description: A pair of close-orbiting Orange Giant stars that share a landable 3.17 g ringed Metal Rich world.

records.name: Crystal Dart Planetary Nebula (Aishaish BF-R e4-7812)
records.description: A tiny dual lobed planetary nebula.

records.name: Atomic Expanse (Blu Euq RQ-J c23-15)
records.description: A tiny landable High Metal Content world with rings that appear gigantic in comparison.

records.name: Anastasia & Drizella (Schee Prue VO-A f1790)
records.description: A white dwarf and its sister neutron star, deceive the visitor with their contrasting natures.

records.name: The Dancing Gardens (Hypuae Aoc OI-K d8-4)
records.description: A binary pair of Earth-like worlds, as well as two terraformable high metal content worlds.

records.name: Little Brother Rock (Oochonz PA-S c6-0)
records.description: A tiny metal rich moon, with a surface radius of 158 km, relatively close to the Core Systems.

records.name: World of Potential Harm (Dryoi Bli EG-Y f1195)
records.description: A landable planet on a highly eccentric orbit that brings it close to a white dwarf star.

records.name: Spikes of Tamirox (M7 Sector KV-A b15-5)
records.description: An inhabited tourist system with collections of Metallic Crystals and Albulum Gourd Molluscs bathed in beautiful golden light.

records.name: Helix Forge (Stuemeae KG-X d1-11)
records.description: Two nested moons orbiting fast and close to their parent moons. Good views from ABC 2, which features sinuous tubers.

records.name: The Aurelian Veil (Eoch Pruae NQ-B c14-239)
records.description: A tight-knit group of 8 bodies close to the secondary star, two of which often collide with one another.

records.name: Family of Giants (Syraleau FH-U e3-1)
records.description: A system with 12 gas giants and 8 stars, four of which are main sequence stars.

records.name: A Song of Distant Earth (Spasau EH-Z c2-0)
records.description: The winner of Distant Worlds 3's "Search for Earth 2.0" project.

records.name: Der Ring des Nibelungen (Athairk EG-Y g474)
records.description: A Class V Gas Giant with a very thin ring, orbiting a twin neutron star binary.

records.name: Gracious Beauty (Synuefe RA-L d9-49)
records.description: A ringed Earth-like world with a tourist beacon nearby.

records.name: A Strand of Hair (Byoo Aec QG-B d14-0)
records.description: A ringed moon of such low mass, that it only has a single exceptionally narrow visible band in its full 11 Mm width.

records.name: Chalcedony Signet (Squern JN-S d4-8)
records.description: A vibrant blue class III gas giant with a metal rich Taylor ring.

records.name: Urania's Doublet (Synuefe VG-S d5-13)
records.description: A gas giant moon with a pair of fine rings, orbiting another gas giant that has massive rings.

records.name: Gaia's Diadem (Synuefe NN-R d5-10)
records.description: An Earth-like world encircled by a delicate asteroid ring. The system is also home to two species of Brain Trees.

records.name: Nyx's World (Trapezium Sector CQ-X c1-5)
records.description: A planet with an atmosphere that's classified as neon-rich but is actually made up of mostly helium, dimly lit by its star, and at night, almost equally by the nearby nebulae of Barnard's Loop.

records.name: LBN 623 Nebula (LBN 623 Sector PD-S b4-5)
records.description: A beautiful purple nebula viewable from several nearby systems. It was colonized during the Trailblazer Initiative in 3311.

records.name: Compitum Saxosum (Musca Dark Region SO-Q b5-5)
records.description: A pair of ringed planets that come so close to each other at periapsis that their rings pass through each other.

records.name: Project Galtea Hub Epsilon (Plio Aihm UC-V d2-159)
records.description: Project Galtea's fifth super supply system, a mega depot supplying tritium and construction commodities.

records.name: Hyacinthum Mortem (HIP 69445)
records.description: A populated system with an Earth-like world, bathed in the light of a Wolf-Rayet star.

records.name: Heaven's Lathe (HD 175876)
records.description: A system dominated by a massive O class star, and a tourist beacon around a ringed neutron star.

records.name: Monza Carousel (Skaudoae AA-A h41)
records.description: A neutron star with a ring that rotates around it every 7.52 minutes, in a system with four black holes.

records.name: Bésixdouze (Spoihaae SJ-Z e350)
records.description: Body 1 a is the record-holder for smallest landable body in the galaxy, as of June 3312.

records.name: Apollo's Envy (Eufac HX-L d7-0)
records.description: Two Earth-Like worlds orbiting 1.5 ls from one another.

records.name: Aurabella's Retreat (Blae Drye TZ-O e6-32)
records.description: An expansive system with numerous ringed bodies, including a heavier (1.5 g) landable thin helium atmospheric world with rings.

records.name: Polycoria Haeretica (Cloomoo IL-Y e1)
records.description: Polycoria Haeretica has a compact four-star hierarchy formed by two distinct, close binaries and a landable world orbiting their shared barycenter. The group is orbited by an A (Blue-White) Star.

records.name: Fornax Vulcani (Iowhaiwsy GB-O d6-12)
records.description: A rare Hot Thin Silicate Vapour atmosphere landable body, scorched by its F-type yellow-white parent star.

records.name: Wreaths of the Olympians (Sifaea BW-E d11-27)
records.description: This system is home to no less than 12 ringed bodies, including a ringed gas giant (8) with five ringed moons. Sometimes all six of them are visible in the same view.

records.name: Daktylíon Pneuma (Hypiae Ausms AA-A h575)
records.description: A system with binary black holes, a ringed neutron star and two gas giants with Taylor rings in close proximity.

records.name: The Crimson Gyre (Voqua AA-A h177)
records.description: A blood-coloured ring of dust and rock orbits a neutron star every 18 minutes, while the neutron star itself orbits two massive black holes.

records.name: Aporia (Systimbu WJ-R e4-720)
records.description: An unassuming Green Gas Giant in the Galactic Centre without any K10-Type Anomalies in the system.

records.name: Sakura's Rings (Gludgaa BQ-W b15-3)
records.description: A gas giant with wide rings and two shepherd moons.

records.name: The Shepherd Giants (Hyuquae MT-H d10-53)
records.description: A collection of giants composed of a ringed gas giant with water-based life, accompanied by two helium-rich gas giant moons close to its rings and a third gas giant with ammonia-based life.

records.name: Enceladus Overlook (Traikeou WM-W d1-28)
records.description: The third planet is a gas giant with wide rings, an inner moon between the two rings, and a ringed moon overlooking it all.

records.name: Project Galtea Hub Zeta (Preae Aihm EH-D d12-64)
records.description: Project Galtea's sixth Super Supply System, providing tritium and colonization goods to the surrounding area.

records.name: XY Lyrae (XY Lyrae)
records.description: Irregular moons provide spectacular views of a red giant star that's also visible in Earth's northern skies.

records.name: Roses Around the Rings (Eon Flye ZA-L d9-2)
records.description: A ringed water world with Rhizome Pods around it.

records.name: Jade Typhoon (Agnairy JH-U e3-2113)
records.description: A planetary nebula encompasses two star systems and a diffuse Lagrange storm cloud with T01-Type Anomalies.

records.name: Ushers of the Five Winds (Eembains UG-S d5-100)
records.description: A system with 75 bodies, including a gas giant with four gas giant moons.

records.name: Izanami Cicadas (Phrio Byoe JH-U d3-12)
records.description: A system with 51 bodies around a single star, featuring moons 6 d and 6 e, which collide every 3.2 years.

records.name: Effulgent Horizon (Eoch Flyuae AA-A h98)
records.description: This system contains a DC-class white dwarf with dark, metal-rich rings

records.name: Soylent Sentinel (Dryaa Blou ER-V d2-2967)
records.description: A solitary Green Gas Giant, with no other planets present in the system.

records.name: Convergent Impact Anomaly (Graea Byio CL-V d3-1)
records.description: A striking formation of nested and overlapping impact craters on the small rocky moon 4 a, forming an eye-like structure visible from orbital approach.

records.name: Project Galtea Hub Eta (Pueloi VY-S d3-94)
records.description: Project Galtea's seventh super hub, providing goods for colonization in the surrounding area and tritium for fleet carriers.

records.name: Peduncle Grazers (Flyaudou FR-M d7-10)
records.description: This system features notable stellar phenomena with peduncle trees and peduncle pods as well as a shepherd moon that grazes its planet's rings.

records.name: Sons of King Endymion (Wepe FG-Y g204)
records.description: Two rocky planets on intersecting orbits collide for nine hours every 800 days, beneath a ringed class T brown dwarf.

records.name: Forbidden Shores (Screaki AA-A h10)
records.description: A terraformable Water world moon orbiting within the exclusion zone of its parent T Tauri star.
